completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
chapter_status_scope: Each chapters entry is one original source section; completed_chapters aggregates all source sections carrying the same native chapter number.

original_book_metadata.source_status: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.text: If you do good, know to whom you do it, and there will be gratitude for your good deeds.
verses.display_text: If you do good, know to whom you do it, and there will be gratitude for your good deeds.

verses.text: Do good to a godly person, and you will find repayment; if not from him, then from the Most High.
verses.display_text: Do good to a godly person, and you will find repayment; if not from him, then from the Most High.

verses.text: There will be no good things for the one who persists in evil and the one who gives no alms.
verses.display_text: There will be no good things for the one who persists in evil and the one who gives no alms.

verses.text: Give to the godly person, and do not support the sinner.
verses.display_text: Give to the godly person, and do not support the sinner.

verses.text: Do good to the humble person, and do not give to the ungodly. Hold back his loaves and do not give them to him, so that he does not use them to overpower you. For you will receive double evils for all the good things you do to him.
verses.display_text: Do good to the humble person, and do not give to the ungodly. Hold back his loaves and do not give them to him, so that he does not use them to overpower you. For you will receive double evils for all the good things you do to him.

verses.text: For the Most High Himself has hated sinners and will repay the ungodly with retribution.
verses.display_text: For the Most High Himself has hated sinners and will repay the ungodly with retribution.

verses.text: Give to the good person, and do not support the sinner.
verses.display_text: Give to the good person, and do not support the sinner.

verses.text: A friend will not be vindicated in prosperity, and an enemy will not remain hidden in adversity.
verses.display_text: A friend will not be vindicated in prosperity, and an enemy will not remain hidden in adversity.

verses.text: When a man prospers, his enemies are in grief; when he suffers adversity, even his friend will separate himself.
verses.display_text: When a man prospers, his enemies are in grief; when he suffers adversity, even his friend will separate himself.

verses.text: Never trust your enemy, for as copper corrodes, so does his wickedness.
verses.display_text: Never trust your enemy, for as copper corrodes, so does his wickedness.

verses.text: Even if he humbles himself and walks bowed down, keep your soul alert and guard against him. You will be toward him like someone who has wiped a mirror, and you will know that it has not completely corroded.
verses.display_text: Even if he humbles himself and walks bowed down, keep your soul alert and guard against him. You will be toward him like someone who has wiped a mirror, and you will know that it has not completely corroded.

verses.text: Do not station him beside yourself, lest he overthrow you and stand in your place. Do not seat him at your right hand, lest he seek your seat; then in the end you will recognize my words and be pierced by my sayings.
verses.display_text: Do not station him beside yourself, lest he overthrow you and stand in your place. Do not seat him at your right hand, lest he seek your seat; then in the end you will recognize my words and be pierced by my sayings.

verses.text: Who will pity a snake-charmer bitten by a serpent, or all those who approach wild beasts?
verses.display_text: Who will pity a snake-charmer bitten by a serpent, or all those who approach wild beasts?

verses.text: So it is with the one who approaches a sinful man and becomes entangled in his sins.
verses.display_text: So it is with the one who approaches a sinful man and becomes entangled in his sins.

verses.text: He will stay with you for an hour, but if you turn aside, he will certainly not hold firm.
verses.display_text: He will stay with you for an hour, but if you turn aside, he will certainly not hold firm.

verses.text: An enemy will make his lips sweet, but in his heart he will plan to throw you into a pit. An enemy will weep with his eyes, but if he finds the occasion, he will not be satisfied with blood.
verses.display_text: An enemy will make his lips sweet, but in his heart he will plan to throw you into a pit. An enemy will weep with his eyes, but if he finds the occasion, he will not be satisfied with blood.

verses.text: If evil things meet you, you will find him there before you; as though helping, he will undermine your heel.
verses.display_text: If evil things meet you, you will find him there before you; as though helping, he will undermine your heel.

verses.text: He will shake his head and clap his hands, whisper many things, and change his expression.
verses.display_text: He will shake his head and clap his hands, whisper many things, and change his expression.

verses.text: The one who touches pitch will be stained, and the one who associates with a proud person will become like him.
verses.display_text: The one who touches pitch will be stained, and the one who associates with a proud person will become like him.

verses.text: Do not lift a burden beyond you, and do not associate with someone stronger and richer than you. What fellowship can an earthen pot have with a cauldron? One will strike, and the other will be shattered.
verses.display_text: Do not lift a burden beyond you, and do not associate with someone stronger and richer than you. What fellowship can an earthen pot have with a cauldron? One will strike, and the other will be shattered.

verses.text: A rich person has done wrong, yet he has added threats; a poor person has been wronged, yet he will add entreaties.
verses.display_text: A rich person has done wrong, yet he has added threats; a poor person has been wronged, yet he will add entreaties.

verses.text: If you are useful, he makes use of you; if you are in want, he will abandon you.
verses.display_text: If you are useful, he makes use of you; if you are in want, he will abandon you.

verses.text: If you have something, he will live with you and empty you out, while he himself takes no trouble.
verses.display_text: If you have something, he will live with you and empty you out, while he himself takes no trouble.

verses.text: He needs you, and he will mislead you, smile at you, and give you hope. He will say pleasant things to you and ask, “What do you need?”
verses.display_text: He needs you, and he will mislead you, smile at you, and give you hope. He will say pleasant things to you and ask, “What do you need?”

verses.text: He will shame you with his food until he has emptied you out twice or three times, and in the end he will mock you. After this he will see you and abandon you and shake his head at you.
verses.display_text: He will shame you with his food until he has emptied you out twice or three times, and in the end he will mock you. After this he will see you and abandon you and shake his head at you.

verses.text: Take care not to be misled or brought low through your folly.
verses.display_text: Take care not to be misled or brought low through your folly.

verses.text: When a powerful person summons you, be retiring, and he will summon you all the more.
verses.display_text: When a powerful person summons you, be retiring, and he will summon you all the more.

verses.text: Do not thrust yourself forward, lest you be pushed away; do not stand too far off, so that you are not forgotten.
verses.display_text: Do not thrust yourself forward, lest you be pushed away; do not stand too far off, so that you are not forgotten.

verses.text: Do not insist on speaking with him as an equal, and do not trust his many words. For through much talk he will test you and examine you as though smiling.
verses.display_text: Do not insist on speaking with him as an equal, and do not trust his many words. For through much talk he will test you and examine you as though smiling.

verses.text: Merciless is the one who does not keep words to himself, and he will certainly not spare you harm and bonds.
verses.display_text: Merciless is the one who does not keep words to himself, and he will certainly not spare you harm and bonds.

verses.text: Keep watch and take very great care, because you are walking alongside your downfall.
verses.display_text: Keep watch and take very great care, because you are walking alongside your downfall.

verses.text: Every living creature loves its like, and every person his neighbor.
verses.display_text: Every living creature loves its like, and every person his neighbor.

verses.text: All flesh gathers according to kind, and a man will cling to someone like himself.
verses.display_text: All flesh gathers according to kind, and a man will cling to someone like himself.

verses.text: What fellowship can a wolf have with a lamb? So it is with a sinner and a godly person.
verses.display_text: What fellowship can a wolf have with a lamb? So it is with a sinner and a godly person.

verses.text: What peace can a hyena have with a dog? What peace can a rich person have with a poor one?
verses.display_text: What peace can a hyena have with a dog? What peace can a rich person have with a poor one?

verses.text: Wild asses in the wilderness are prey for lions; so the poor are feeding grounds for the rich.
verses.display_text: Wild asses in the wilderness are prey for lions; so the poor are feeding grounds for the rich.

verses.text: Lowliness is an abomination to the proud; so a poor person is an abomination to the rich.
verses.display_text: Lowliness is an abomination to the proud; so a poor person is an abomination to the rich.

verses.text: A rich person who is shaken is supported by friends; a lowly person who falls is pushed away still further by friends.
verses.display_text: A rich person who is shaken is supported by friends; a lowly person who falls is pushed away still further by friends.

verses.text: When a rich person stumbles, many support him. He spoke things that should not be spoken, and they justified him. A lowly person stumbled, and they added rebuke; he spoke with understanding, and no place was given him.
verses.display_text: When a rich person stumbles, many support him. He spoke things that should not be spoken, and they justified him. A lowly person stumbled, and they added rebuke; he spoke with understanding, and no place was given him.

verses.text: A rich person spoke, and everyone fell silent; they raised his word to the clouds. A poor person spoke, and they said, “Who is this?” If he stumbles, they will throw him down all the more.
verses.display_text: A rich person spoke, and everyone fell silent; they raised his word to the clouds. A poor person spoke, and they said, “Who is this?” If he stumbles, they will throw him down all the more.

verses.text: Wealth is good when no sin accompanies it, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.
verses.display_text: Wealth is good when no sin accompanies it, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.

verses.text: A person’s heart changes his face, whether for good or for evil.
verses.display_text: A person’s heart changes his face, whether for good or for evil.

verses.text: A cheerful face is the trace of a heart in good circumstances, and finding proverbs requires laborious deliberations.
verses.display_text: A cheerful face is the trace of a heart in good circumstances, and finding proverbs requires laborious deliberations.

verses.text: Happy is the man who has not slipped with his mouth and has not been pierced by grief over sins.
verses.display_text: Happy is the man who has not slipped with his mouth and has not been pierced by grief over sins.

verses.text: Happy is the one whose soul has not condemned him and who has not fallen away from his hope.
verses.display_text: Happy is the one whose soul has not condemned him and who has not fallen away from his hope.

verses.text: Wealth is not good for a miserly man; what are possessions for a grudging person?
verses.display_text: Wealth is not good for a miserly man; what are possessions for a grudging person?

verses.text: The one who gathers by depriving his own soul gathers for others, and strangers will enjoy his good things.
verses.display_text: The one who gathers by depriving his own soul gathers for others, and strangers will enjoy his good things.

verses.text: To whom will the one who is bad to himself be good? He will certainly not rejoice in his possessions.
verses.display_text: To whom will the one who is bad to himself be good? He will certainly not rejoice in his possessions.

verses.text: No one is worse than the one who begrudges himself, and this is the repayment of his evil:
verses.display_text: No one is worse than the one who begrudges himself, and this is the repayment of his evil:

verses.text: even if he does good, he does it forgetfully, and in the end he reveals his evil.
verses.display_text: even if he does good, he does it forgetfully, and in the end he reveals his evil.

verses.text: Evil is the one who begrudges with his eye, turning his face away and disregarding souls.
verses.display_text: Evil is the one who begrudges with his eye, turning his face away and disregarding souls.

verses.text: A greedy person’s eye is not satisfied with its portion, and evil injustice dries up the soul.
verses.display_text: A greedy person’s eye is not satisfied with its portion, and evil injustice dries up the soul.

verses.text: An evil eye begrudges bread, and his own table is lacking.
verses.display_text: An evil eye begrudges bread, and his own table is lacking.

verses.text: Child, do yourself good according to what you have, and bring offerings worthily to the Lord.
verses.display_text: Child, do yourself good according to what you have, and bring offerings worthily to the Lord.

verses.text: Remember that death will not delay, and the covenant of Hades has not been shown to you.
verses.display_text: Remember that death will not delay, and the covenant of Hades has not been shown to you.

verses.text: Before you die, do good to a friend; according to your strength, reach out and give to him.
verses.display_text: Before you die, do good to a friend; according to your strength, reach out and give to him.

verses.text: Do not miss a good day, and do not let your share of a good desire pass you by.
verses.display_text: Do not miss a good day, and do not let your share of a good desire pass you by.

verses.text: Will you not leave your labors to another, and your toils to the division of an inheritance?
verses.display_text: Will you not leave your labors to another, and your toils to the division of an inheritance?

verses.text: Give and receive, and beguile your soul, for in Hades there is no seeking luxury.
verses.display_text: Give and receive, and beguile your soul, for in Hades there is no seeking luxury.

verses.text: All flesh grows old like a garment, for the covenant from eternity is, “You will surely die.”
verses.display_text: All flesh grows old like a garment, for the covenant from eternity is, “You will surely die.”

verses.text: Like flourishing foliage on a leafy tree—some it casts down, while other leaves it grows—so is a generation of flesh and blood: one dies, and another is born.
verses.display_text: Like flourishing foliage on a leafy tree—some it casts down, while other leaves it grows—so is a generation of flesh and blood: one dies, and another is born.

verses.text: Every decaying work comes to an end, and its maker will depart with it.
verses.display_text: Every decaying work comes to an end, and its maker will depart with it.

verses.text: Happy is the man who will meditate on wisdom and speak with his understanding,
verses.display_text: Happy is the man who will meditate on wisdom and speak with his understanding,

verses.text: who considers her ways in his heart and will reflect upon her hidden things.
verses.display_text: who considers her ways in his heart and will reflect upon her hidden things.

verses.text: Go out after her like a tracker, and lie in wait on her paths.
verses.display_text: Go out after her like a tracker, and lie in wait on her paths.

verses.text: The one who peers through her windows will also listen at her doorways;
verses.display_text: The one who peers through her windows will also listen at her doorways;

verses.text: the one who lodges near her house will fix a tent peg in her walls.
verses.display_text: the one who lodges near her house will fix a tent peg in her walls.

verses.text: He will pitch his tent beside her and lodge in a lodging of good things.
verses.display_text: He will pitch his tent beside her and lodge in a lodging of good things.

verses.text: He will place his children in her shelter and spend the night beneath her branches.
verses.display_text: He will place his children in her shelter and spend the night beneath her branches.

verses.text: He will be sheltered by her from the heat and lodge in her glory.
verses.display_text: He will be sheltered by her from the heat and lodge in her glory.

verses.text: The one who fears the Lord will do this, and the one who holds fast to the law will gain her.
verses.display_text: The one who fears the Lord will do this, and the one who holds fast to the law will gain her.

verses.text: She will meet him like a mother and welcome him like a wife of his youth.
verses.display_text: She will meet him like a mother and welcome him like a wife of his youth.

verses.text: She will feed him bread of understanding and give him water of wisdom to drink.
verses.display_text: She will feed him bread of understanding and give him water of wisdom to drink.

verses.text: He will lean upon her and certainly not be shaken; he will hold to her and certainly not be put to shame.
verses.display_text: He will lean upon her and certainly not be shaken; he will hold to her and certainly not be put to shame.

verses.text: She will raise him above his neighbors and open his mouth in the midst of the assembly.
verses.display_text: She will raise him above his neighbors and open his mouth in the midst of the assembly.

verses.text: He will find gladness and a crown of rejoicing, and inherit an everlasting name.
verses.display_text: He will find gladness and a crown of rejoicing, and inherit an everlasting name.

verses.text: People without understanding will certainly not gain her, and sinful men will certainly not see her.
verses.display_text: People without understanding will certainly not gain her, and sinful men will certainly not see her.

verses.text: She is far from pride, and lying men will certainly not remember her.
verses.display_text: She is far from pride, and lying men will certainly not remember her.

verses.text: Praise is not fitting in a sinner’s mouth, because it was not sent from the Lord.
verses.display_text: Praise is not fitting in a sinner’s mouth, because it was not sent from the Lord.

verses.text: For praise will be spoken in wisdom, and the Lord will cause it to prosper.
verses.display_text: For praise will be spoken in wisdom, and the Lord will cause it to prosper.

verses.text: Do not say, “Because of the Lord I fell away,” for He will not do the things He hates.
verses.display_text: Do not say, “Because of the Lord I fell away,” for He will not do the things He hates.

verses.text: Do not say, “He Himself led me astray,” for He has no need of a sinful man.
verses.display_text: Do not say, “He Himself led me astray,” for He has no need of a sinful man.

verses.text: The Lord has hated every abomination, and it is not loved by those who fear Him.
verses.display_text: The Lord has hated every abomination, and it is not loved by those who fear Him.

verses.text: He Himself made the human being from the beginning and left him in the hand of his own deliberation.
verses.display_text: He Himself made the human being from the beginning and left him in the hand of his own deliberation.

verses.text: If you are willing, you will keep the commandments; to act faithfully is a matter of good will.
verses.display_text: If you are willing, you will keep the commandments; to act faithfully is a matter of good will.

verses.text: He has placed fire and water before you; toward whichever you wish, you will stretch out your hand.
verses.display_text: He has placed fire and water before you; toward whichever you wish, you will stretch out your hand.

verses.text: Before human beings are life and death, and whichever a person chooses will be given to him.
verses.display_text: Before human beings are life and death, and whichever a person chooses will be given to him.

verses.text: For the Lord’s wisdom is great; He is strong in dominion and sees all things.
verses.display_text: For the Lord’s wisdom is great; He is strong in dominion and sees all things.

verses.text: His eyes are upon those who fear Him, and He Himself will know every human deed.
verses.display_text: His eyes are upon those who fear Him, and He Himself will know every human deed.

verses.text: He commanded no one to act ungodly, and He gave no one license to sin.
verses.display_text: He commanded no one to act ungodly, and He gave no one license to sin.

verses.text: Do not desire a multitude of useless children, or rejoice in ungodly sons.
verses.display_text: Do not desire a multitude of useless children, or rejoice in ungodly sons.

verses.text: Even if they multiply, do not rejoice in them unless the fear of the Lord is with them.
verses.display_text: Even if they multiply, do not rejoice in them unless the fear of the Lord is with them.

verses.text: Do not trust in their life or rely on their multitude. For one is better than a thousand, and it is better to die childless than to have ungodly children.
verses.display_text: Do not trust in their life or rely on their multitude. For one is better than a thousand, and it is better to die childless than to have ungodly children.

verses.text: For through one understanding person a city will be settled, but a tribe of lawless people will become desolate.
verses.display_text: For through one understanding person a city will be settled, but a tribe of lawless people will become desolate.

verses.text: My eye has seen many such things, and my ear has heard things stronger than these.
verses.display_text: My eye has seen many such things, and my ear has heard things stronger than these.

verses.text: In an assembly of sinners fire will be kindled, and in a disobedient nation wrath was kindled.
verses.display_text: In an assembly of sinners fire will be kindled, and in a disobedient nation wrath was kindled.

verses.text: He did not make atonement for the ancient giants, who rebelled in their strength.
verses.display_text: He did not make atonement for the ancient giants, who rebelled in their strength.

verses.text: He did not spare Lot’s neighbors, whom He loathed because of their pride.
verses.display_text: He did not spare Lot’s neighbors, whom He loathed because of their pride.

verses.text: He did not have mercy on the nation of destruction, those carried away in their sins,
verses.display_text: He did not have mercy on the nation of destruction, those carried away in their sins,

verses.text: and likewise on the six hundred thousand foot soldiers gathered together in their hardness of heart.
verses.display_text: and likewise on the six hundred thousand foot soldiers gathered together in their hardness of heart.

verses.text: Even if there is one stiff-necked person, it is a wonder if he will be acquitted. For mercy and wrath are with Him; He is mighty in atonements and pours out wrath.
verses.display_text: Even if there is one stiff-necked person, it is a wonder if he will be acquitted. For mercy and wrath are with Him; He is mighty in atonements and pours out wrath.

verses.text: As His mercy is great, so also His rebuke is great; He will judge a man according to his deeds.
verses.display_text: As His mercy is great, so also His rebuke is great; He will judge a man according to his deeds.

verses.text: A sinner will not escape with his plunder, and a godly person’s endurance will certainly not be left behind.
verses.display_text: A sinner will not escape with his plunder, and a godly person’s endurance will certainly not be left behind.

verses.text: He will make room for every act of almsgiving; each person will receive according to his deeds.
verses.display_text: He will make room for every act of almsgiving; each person will receive according to his deeds.

verses.text: Do not say, “I will be hidden from the Lord; who will remember me from on high? Among a numerous people I will certainly not be known, for what is my soul in the immeasurable creation?”
verses.display_text: Do not say, “I will be hidden from the Lord; who will remember me from on high? Among a numerous people I will certainly not be known, for what is my soul in the immeasurable creation?”

verses.text: Behold, heaven and the heaven of heaven, the abyss and the earth will be shaken at His visitation.
verses.display_text: Behold, heaven and the heaven of heaven, the abyss and the earth will be shaken at His visitation.

verses.text: Together the mountains and the foundations of the earth are shaken with trembling when He looks upon them.
verses.display_text: Together the mountains and the foundations of the earth are shaken with trembling when He looks upon them.

verses.text: Yet no heart will consider these things, and who will ponder His ways?
verses.display_text: Yet no heart will consider these things, and who will ponder His ways?

verses.text: There is also a tempest that a person will not see, and most of His works are hidden.
verses.display_text: There is also a tempest that a person will not see, and most of His works are hidden.

verses.text: Who will announce works of righteousness? Who will wait? For the covenant is far away.
verses.display_text: Who will announce works of righteousness? Who will wait? For the covenant is far away.

verses.text: Someone deficient in heart thinks these things; a foolish and wandering man thinks foolish things.
verses.display_text: Someone deficient in heart thinks these things; a foolish and wandering man thinks foolish things.

verses.text: Listen to me, child, and learn knowledge; attend to my words with your heart.
verses.display_text: Listen to me, child, and learn knowledge; attend to my words with your heart.

verses.text: I will disclose instruction by measure and declare knowledge with precision.
verses.display_text: I will disclose instruction by measure and declare knowledge with precision.

verses.text: By the Lord’s judgment His works have existed from the beginning; from their making He distinguished their portions.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s judgment His works have existed from the beginning; from their making He distinguished their portions.

verses.text: He ordered His works for ever and their dominions through their generations. They neither hungered nor grew weary, and they did not cease from their tasks.
verses.display_text: He ordered His works for ever and their dominions through their generations. They neither hungered nor grew weary, and they did not cease from their tasks.

verses.text: None crowded out its neighbor, and for ever they will not disobey His word.
verses.display_text: None crowded out its neighbor, and for ever they will not disobey His word.

verses.text: After these things the Lord looked upon the earth and filled it with His good things.
verses.display_text: After these things the Lord looked upon the earth and filled it with His good things.

verses.text: He covered its face with the life of every living creature, and to it they return.
verses.display_text: He covered its face with the life of every living creature, and to it they return.

verses.text: The Lord created a human being from earth and returned him to it again.
verses.display_text: The Lord created a human being from earth and returned him to it again.

verses.text: He gave them numbered days and an appointed time, and He gave them authority over the things upon it.
verses.display_text: He gave them numbered days and an appointed time, and He gave them authority over the things upon it.

verses.text: He clothed them with strength like His own and made them according to His image.
verses.display_text: He clothed them with strength like His own and made them according to His image.

verses.text: He placed the fear of the human being upon all flesh and granted dominion over beasts and winged creatures.
verses.display_text: He placed the fear of the human being upon all flesh and granted dominion over beasts and winged creatures.

verses.text: He gave them deliberation, a tongue and eyes, ears and a heart for understanding.
verses.display_text: He gave them deliberation, a tongue and eyes, ears and a heart for understanding.

verses.text: He filled them with discerning knowledge and showed them good things and evil things.
verses.display_text: He filled them with discerning knowledge and showed them good things and evil things.

verses.text: He set His eye upon their hearts to show them the greatness of His works,
verses.display_text: He set His eye upon their hearts to show them the greatness of His works,

verses.text: and they will praise the holy name, so that they may recount the greatness of His works.
verses.display_text: and they will praise the holy name, so that they may recount the greatness of His works.

verses.text: He added knowledge to them and gave them the law of life as an inheritance.
verses.display_text: He added knowledge to them and gave them the law of life as an inheritance.

verses.text: He established an everlasting covenant with them and showed them His judgments.
verses.display_text: He established an everlasting covenant with them and showed them His judgments.

verses.text: Their eyes saw the greatness of glory, and their ear heard the glory of His voice.
verses.display_text: Their eyes saw the greatness of glory, and their ear heard the glory of His voice.

verses.text: He said to them, “Beware of every injustice,” and commanded each of them concerning the neighbor.
verses.display_text: He said to them, “Beware of every injustice,” and commanded each of them concerning the neighbor.

verses.text: Their ways are continually before Him; they will not be hidden from His eyes.
verses.display_text: Their ways are continually before Him; they will not be hidden from His eyes.

verses.text: He appointed a ruler for each nation, but Israel is the Lord’s portion.
verses.display_text: He appointed a ruler for each nation, but Israel is the Lord’s portion.

verses.text: All their works are like the sun before Him, and His eyes are continually upon their ways.
verses.display_text: All their works are like the sun before Him, and His eyes are continually upon their ways.

verses.text: Their injustices were not hidden from Him, and all their sins are before the Lord.
verses.display_text: Their injustices were not hidden from Him, and all their sins are before the Lord.

verses.text: A man’s almsgiving is like a seal with Him, and He will guard human kindness like the pupil of an eye.
verses.display_text: A man’s almsgiving is like a seal with Him, and He will guard human kindness like the pupil of an eye.

verses.text: After these things He will rise and repay them; He will return their recompense upon their head.
verses.display_text: After these things He will rise and repay them; He will return their recompense upon their head.

verses.text: Yet He gave a way back to those who repent and encouraged those whose endurance was failing.
verses.display_text: Yet He gave a way back to those who repent and encouraged those whose endurance was failing.

verses.text: Return to the Lord and leave sins behind; petition Him face to face and lessen your stumbling.
verses.display_text: Return to the Lord and leave sins behind; petition Him face to face and lessen your stumbling.

verses.text: Come back to the Most High, turn away from injustice, and hate abomination intensely.
verses.display_text: Come back to the Most High, turn away from injustice, and hate abomination intensely.

verses.text: Who in Hades will praise the Most High in place of the living who give acknowledgment?
verses.display_text: Who in Hades will praise the Most High in place of the living who give acknowledgment?

verses.text: From the dead, as from one who does not exist, thanksgiving perishes; the living and healthy will praise the Lord.
verses.display_text: From the dead, as from one who does not exist, thanksgiving perishes; the living and healthy will praise the Lord.

verses.text: How great is the Lord’s mercy and His atonement for those who return to Him!
verses.display_text: How great is the Lord’s mercy and His atonement for those who return to Him!

verses.text: For human beings cannot have everything, because a son of man is not immortal.
verses.display_text: For human beings cannot have everything, because a son of man is not immortal.

verses.text: What is brighter than the sun? Yet even it fails; and flesh and blood will conceive evil.
verses.display_text: What is brighter than the sun? Yet even it fails; and flesh and blood will conceive evil.

verses.text: He Himself surveys the power of the height of heaven, but all human beings are earth and ashes.
verses.display_text: He Himself surveys the power of the height of heaven, but all human beings are earth and ashes.

verses.text: He who lives for ever created all things together.
verses.display_text: He who lives for ever created all things together.

verses.text: The Lord alone will be justified.
verses.display_text: The Lord alone will be justified.

verses.text: He has empowered no one to declare His works fully; who will trace out His mighty deeds?
verses.display_text: He has empowered no one to declare His works fully; who will trace out His mighty deeds?

verses.text: Who will count the might of His greatness? Who will go on to recount His mercies?
verses.display_text: Who will count the might of His greatness? Who will go on to recount His mercies?

verses.text: It is impossible to diminish or to add, and impossible to trace out the Lord’s wonders.
verses.display_text: It is impossible to diminish or to add, and impossible to trace out the Lord’s wonders.

verses.text: When a person finishes, then he begins; when he stops, then he will be at a loss.
verses.display_text: When a person finishes, then he begins; when he stops, then he will be at a loss.

verses.text: What is a human being, and what is his use? What is his good, and what is his evil?
verses.display_text: What is a human being, and what is his use? What is his good, and what is his evil?

verses.text: The number of a person’s days, in many years, is a hundred.
verses.display_text: The number of a person’s days, in many years, is a hundred.

verses.text: Like a drop of water from the sea or a grain of sand, so are a few years in a day of eternity.
verses.display_text: Like a drop of water from the sea or a grain of sand, so are a few years in a day of eternity.

verses.text: Therefore the Lord was patient with them and poured His mercy upon them.
verses.display_text: Therefore the Lord was patient with them and poured His mercy upon them.

verses.text: He saw and knew that their end was grievous; therefore He multiplied His atonement.
verses.display_text: He saw and knew that their end was grievous; therefore He multiplied His atonement.

verses.text: A person’s mercy is toward his neighbor, but the Lord’s mercy is upon all flesh: rebuking, disciplining, teaching, and bringing back like a shepherd his flock.
verses.display_text: A person’s mercy is toward his neighbor, but the Lord’s mercy is upon all flesh: rebuking, disciplining, teaching, and bringing back like a shepherd his flock.

verses.text: He has mercy on those who receive discipline and those who hasten eagerly toward His judgments.
verses.display_text: He has mercy on those who receive discipline and those who hasten eagerly toward His judgments.

verses.text: Child, do not add reproach to good deeds, or the grief of words to any gift.
verses.display_text: Child, do not add reproach to good deeds, or the grief of words to any gift.

verses.text: Will not dew bring relief from scorching heat? So a word is better than a gift.
verses.display_text: Will not dew bring relief from scorching heat? So a word is better than a gift.

verses.text: Behold, is not a word beyond a good gift? Yet both are found with a gracious man.
verses.display_text: Behold, is not a word beyond a good gift? Yet both are found with a gracious man.

verses.text: A fool will reproach gracelessly, and a grudging person’s gift makes eyes waste away.
verses.display_text: A fool will reproach gracelessly, and a grudging person’s gift makes eyes waste away.

verses.text: Learn before speaking, and attend to your health before illness.
verses.display_text: Learn before speaking, and attend to your health before illness.

verses.text: Examine yourself before judgment, and at the hour of visitation you will find atonement.
verses.display_text: Examine yourself before judgment, and at the hour of visitation you will find atonement.

verses.text: Humble yourself before you fall ill, and show repentance at the time of sins.
verses.display_text: Humble yourself before you fall ill, and show repentance at the time of sins.

verses.text: Do not be held back from repaying a vow at the right time, and do not wait until death to be justified.
verses.display_text: Do not be held back from repaying a vow at the right time, and do not wait until death to be justified.

verses.text: Prepare yourself before making a vow, and do not become like a person testing the Lord.
verses.display_text: Prepare yourself before making a vow, and do not become like a person testing the Lord.

verses.text: Remember wrath in the days of death, and the time of retribution when the face is turned away.
verses.display_text: Remember wrath in the days of death, and the time of retribution when the face is turned away.

verses.text: Remember a time of famine in a time of fullness, poverty and need in days of wealth.
verses.display_text: Remember a time of famine in a time of fullness, poverty and need in days of wealth.

verses.text: From morning until evening the time changes, and all things are swift before the Lord.
verses.display_text: From morning until evening the time changes, and all things are swift before the Lord.

verses.text: A wise person will be cautious in everything, and in days of sins will guard against wrongdoing.
verses.display_text: A wise person will be cautious in everything, and in days of sins will guard against wrongdoing.

verses.text: Every understanding person has known wisdom and will give acknowledgment to the one who finds her.
verses.display_text: Every understanding person has known wisdom and will give acknowledgment to the one who finds her.

verses.text: Those understanding in words have themselves become wise and rained down precise proverbs.
verses.display_text: Those understanding in words have themselves become wise and rained down precise proverbs.

verses.text: Do not walk after your desires, and restrain your appetites.
verses.display_text: Do not walk after your desires, and restrain your appetites.

verses.text: If you supply your soul with the satisfaction of desire, it will make you an object of your enemies’ gloating.
verses.display_text: If you supply your soul with the satisfaction of desire, it will make you an object of your enemies’ gloating.

verses.text: Do not rejoice in great luxury, lest you be bound to contribute to it.
verses.display_text: Do not rejoice in great luxury, lest you be bound to contribute to it.

verses.text: Do not become poor by feasting on borrowed money when you have nothing in your purse.
verses.display_text: Do not become poor by feasting on borrowed money when you have nothing in your purse.

verses.text: A drunken worker will not become rich; the one who despises small things will fall little by little.
verses.display_text: A drunken worker will not become rich; the one who despises small things will fall little by little.

verses.text: Wine and women will lead understanding men astray, and the one who clings to prostitutes will become more reckless.
verses.display_text: Wine and women will lead understanding men astray, and the one who clings to prostitutes will become more reckless.

verses.text: Rot and worms will inherit him, and a reckless soul will be taken away.
verses.display_text: Rot and worms will inherit him, and a reckless soul will be taken away.

verses.text: The one who trusts quickly is lighthearted, and the one who sins will wrong his own soul.
verses.display_text: The one who trusts quickly is lighthearted, and the one who sins will wrong his own soul.

verses.text: The one who rejoices in heart will be condemned,
verses.display_text: The one who rejoices in heart will be condemned,

verses.text: but the one who hates chatter diminishes evil.
verses.display_text: but the one who hates chatter diminishes evil.

verses.text: Never repeat a word, and you will certainly lose nothing.
verses.display_text: Never repeat a word, and you will certainly lose nothing.

verses.text: Do not tell it to friend or enemy, and unless silence is a sin for you, do not reveal it.
verses.display_text: Do not tell it to friend or enemy, and unless silence is a sin for you, do not reveal it.

verses.text: For someone has heard you and kept watch on you, and in time he will hate you.
verses.display_text: For someone has heard you and kept watch on you, and in time he will hate you.

verses.text: Have you heard a word? Let it die with you. Take courage; it will certainly not make you burst.
verses.display_text: Have you heard a word? Let it die with you. Take courage; it will certainly not make you burst.

verses.text: A fool will suffer labor pains over a word, like a woman giving birth over her baby.
verses.display_text: A fool will suffer labor pains over a word, like a woman giving birth over her baby.

verses.text: An arrow fixed in the flesh of a thigh—so is a word in a fool’s belly.
verses.display_text: An arrow fixed in the flesh of a thigh—so is a word in a fool’s belly.

verses.text: Question a friend; perhaps he did not do it, and if he did, question him so that he may not repeat it.
verses.display_text: Question a friend; perhaps he did not do it, and if he did, question him so that he may not repeat it.

verses.text: Question your neighbor; perhaps he did not say it, and if he has said it, question him so that he may not say it again.
verses.display_text: Question your neighbor; perhaps he did not say it, and if he has said it, question him so that he may not say it again.

verses.text: Question a friend, for slander often occurs; do not trust every report.
verses.display_text: Question a friend, for slander often occurs; do not trust every report.

verses.text: There is someone who slips without intending it in his soul; who has not sinned with his tongue?
verses.display_text: There is someone who slips without intending it in his soul; who has not sinned with his tongue?

verses.text: Question your neighbor before threatening him, and give place to the law of the Most High.
verses.display_text: Question your neighbor before threatening him, and give place to the law of the Most High.

verses.text: All wisdom is fear of the Lord, and in all wisdom there is doing the law.
verses.display_text: All wisdom is fear of the Lord, and in all wisdom there is doing the law.

verses.text: Knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, and where sinners take counsel there is no prudence.
verses.display_text: Knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, and where sinners take counsel there is no prudence.

verses.text: There is shrewdness that is an abomination, and there is a foolish person deficient in wisdom.
verses.display_text: There is shrewdness that is an abomination, and there is a foolish person deficient in wisdom.

verses.text: Better someone lacking understanding but full of fear than someone abounding in prudence who transgresses the law.
verses.display_text: Better someone lacking understanding but full of fear than someone abounding in prudence who transgresses the law.

verses.text: There is precise shrewdness that is unjust, and there is someone who twists matters in order to bring a judgment to light.
verses.display_text: There is precise shrewdness that is unjust, and there is someone who twists matters in order to bring a judgment to light.

verses.text: There is someone who acts wickedly while bowed down in gloom, with his inward parts full of deceit.
verses.display_text: There is someone who acts wickedly while bowed down in gloom, with his inward parts full of deceit.

verses.text: Hiding his face and pretending to be deaf, where he has not been recognized he will get ahead of you.
verses.display_text: Hiding his face and pretending to be deaf, where he has not been recognized he will get ahead of you.

verses.text: If lack of strength prevents him from sinning, he will do evil when he finds an opportunity.
verses.display_text: If lack of strength prevents him from sinning, he will do evil when he finds an opportunity.

verses.text: A man will be recognized from his appearance, and an understanding person from the look of his face.
verses.display_text: A man will be recognized from his appearance, and an understanding person from the look of his face.

verses.text: A man’s clothing, the grin of his teeth, and a person’s steps will declare what he is like.
verses.display_text: A man’s clothing, the grin of his teeth, and a person’s steps will declare what he is like.

verses.text: There is a rebuke that is not fitting, and there is a silent person who is prudent.
verses.display_text: There is a rebuke that is not fitting, and there is a silent person who is prudent.

verses.text: How much better to rebuke than to be angry,
verses.display_text: How much better to rebuke than to be angry,

verses.text: and the one who acknowledges his fault will be kept from loss.
verses.display_text: and the one who acknowledges his fault will be kept from loss.

verses.text: A eunuch’s desire to take a young woman’s virginity—so is the one who carries out judgments by force.
verses.display_text: A eunuch’s desire to take a young woman’s virginity—so is the one who carries out judgments by force.

verses.text: There is a silent person who is found wise, and there is someone hated for much chatter.
verses.display_text: There is a silent person who is found wise, and there is someone hated for much chatter.

verses.text: There is someone silent because he has no answer, and someone silent because he knows the right time.
verses.display_text: There is someone silent because he has no answer, and someone silent because he knows the right time.

verses.text: A wise person will keep silent until the right time, but a babbler and a fool will miss the right time.
verses.display_text: A wise person will keep silent until the right time, but a babbler and a fool will miss the right time.

verses.text: The one who multiplies words will be loathed, and the one who assumes authority will be hated.
verses.display_text: The one who multiplies words will be loathed, and the one who assumes authority will be hated.

verses.text: There is success for a man amid adversity, and there is a gain that brings loss.
verses.display_text: There is success for a man amid adversity, and there is a gain that brings loss.

verses.text: There is a gift that will not benefit you, and a gift whose repayment is double.
verses.display_text: There is a gift that will not benefit you, and a gift whose repayment is double.

verses.text: There is loss for the sake of glory, and there is someone who has lifted his head from lowliness.
verses.display_text: There is loss for the sake of glory, and there is someone who has lifted his head from lowliness.

verses.text: There is someone who buys much for little and pays for it sevenfold.
verses.display_text: There is someone who buys much for little and pays for it sevenfold.

verses.text: A wise person will make himself welcome by his words, but fools’ favors will be wasted.
verses.display_text: A wise person will make himself welcome by his words, but fools’ favors will be wasted.

verses.text: An unthinking person’s gift will not benefit you, for his eyes seek many things in exchange for one.
verses.display_text: An unthinking person’s gift will not benefit you, for his eyes seek many things in exchange for one.

verses.text: He will give little and reproach much, and open his mouth like a herald. Today he will lend, and tomorrow he will demand repayment; such a person is hateful.
verses.display_text: He will give little and reproach much, and open his mouth like a herald. Today he will lend, and tomorrow he will demand repayment; such a person is hateful.

verses.text: A fool will say, “I have no friend, and there is no gratitude for my good deeds.”
verses.display_text: A fool will say, “I have no friend, and there is no gratitude for my good deeds.”

verses.text: Those who eat his bread are base in speech. How often, and how many, will laugh at him?
verses.display_text: Those who eat his bread are base in speech. How often, and how many, will laugh at him?

verses.text: Better a slip on the ground than a slip of the tongue; so the fall of the wicked will come swiftly.
verses.display_text: Better a slip on the ground than a slip of the tongue; so the fall of the wicked will come swiftly.

verses.text: A graceless person is an untimely tale; it will be continually in the mouth of the uninstructed.
verses.display_text: A graceless person is an untimely tale; it will be continually in the mouth of the uninstructed.

verses.text: A proverb will be rejected from a fool’s mouth, for he will certainly not say it at its proper time.
verses.display_text: A proverb will be rejected from a fool’s mouth, for he will certainly not say it at its proper time.

verses.text: There is someone prevented from sinning by need; in his rest he will not be pierced with remorse.
verses.display_text: There is someone prevented from sinning by need; in his rest he will not be pierced with remorse.

verses.text: There is someone who destroys his soul through shame, and through regard for a foolish face he will lose it.
verses.display_text: There is someone who destroys his soul through shame, and through regard for a foolish face he will lose it.

verses.text: There is someone who makes a promise to a friend because of shame, and has acquired him as an enemy for nothing.
verses.display_text: There is someone who makes a promise to a friend because of shame, and has acquired him as an enemy for nothing.

verses.text: A lie is an evil blemish in a person; it will be continually in the mouth of the uninstructed.
verses.display_text: A lie is an evil blemish in a person; it will be continually in the mouth of the uninstructed.

verses.text: A thief is preferable to someone who persists in lying, but both will inherit destruction.
verses.display_text: A thief is preferable to someone who persists in lying, but both will inherit destruction.

verses.text: A lying person’s character is dishonor, and his shame is continually with him.
verses.display_text: A lying person’s character is dishonor, and his shame is continually with him.

verses.text: A wise person will advance himself through his words, and a prudent man will please dignitaries.
verses.display_text: A wise person will advance himself through his words, and a prudent man will please dignitaries.

verses.text: The one who works the land will raise his heap of grain, and the one who pleases dignitaries will atone for injustice.
verses.display_text: The one who works the land will raise his heap of grain, and the one who pleases dignitaries will atone for injustice.

verses.text: Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise and turn aside rebukes like a muzzle in the mouth.
verses.display_text: Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise and turn aside rebukes like a muzzle in the mouth.

verses.text: Hidden wisdom and an unseen treasure—what benefit is there in either?
verses.display_text: Hidden wisdom and an unseen treasure—what benefit is there in either?

verses.text: Better a person who hides his foolishness than a person who hides his wisdom.
verses.display_text: Better a person who hides his foolishness than a person who hides his wisdom.

verses.text: Child, have you sinned? Do not add to it any more, and pray concerning your earlier sins.
verses.display_text: Child, have you sinned? Do not add to it any more, and pray concerning your earlier sins.

verses.text: Flee from sin as from the presence of a snake, for if you approach it, it will bite you. Its teeth are lions’ teeth, destroying human lives.
verses.display_text: Flee from sin as from the presence of a snake, for if you approach it, it will bite you. Its teeth are lions’ teeth, destroying human lives.

verses.text: All lawlessness is like a two-edged sword; there is no healing for its wound.
verses.display_text: All lawlessness is like a two-edged sword; there is no healing for its wound.

verses.text: Intimidation and insolence will lay wealth waste; so the house of a proud person will be laid waste.
verses.display_text: Intimidation and insolence will lay wealth waste; so the house of a proud person will be laid waste.

verses.text: A poor person’s petition goes from his mouth to His ears, and His judgment comes swiftly.
verses.display_text: A poor person’s petition goes from his mouth to His ears, and His judgment comes swiftly.

verses.text: The one who hates rebuke is in a sinner’s tracks, but the one who fears the Lord will turn back in heart.
verses.display_text: The one who hates rebuke is in a sinner’s tracks, but the one who fears the Lord will turn back in heart.

verses.text: One who is powerful with the tongue is known from far away, but an understanding person knows when he slips.
verses.display_text: One who is powerful with the tongue is known from far away, but an understanding person knows when he slips.

verses.text: The one who builds his house with others’ money is like someone gathering its stones for a storm.
verses.display_text: The one who builds his house with others’ money is like someone gathering its stones for a storm.

verses.text: An assembly of the lawless is gathered tow, and their end is a flame of fire.
verses.display_text: An assembly of the lawless is gathered tow, and their end is a flame of fire.

verses.text: The sinners’ road is smoothed with stones, but at its end is the pit of Hades.
verses.display_text: The sinners’ road is smoothed with stones, but at its end is the pit of Hades.

verses.text: The one who keeps the law masters his thoughts, and wisdom is the fulfillment of the fear of the Lord.
verses.display_text: The one who keeps the law masters his thoughts, and wisdom is the fulfillment of the fear of the Lord.

verses.text: The one who is not shrewd will not be instructed, yet there is a shrewdness that multiplies bitterness.
verses.display_text: The one who is not shrewd will not be instructed, yet there is a shrewdness that multiplies bitterness.

verses.text: A wise person’s knowledge will increase like a flood, and his counsel is like a spring of life.
verses.display_text: A wise person’s knowledge will increase like a flood, and his counsel is like a spring of life.

verses.text: A fool’s inward parts are like a broken vessel; he will retain no knowledge.
verses.display_text: A fool’s inward parts are like a broken vessel; he will retain no knowledge.

verses.text: If a knowledgeable person hears a wise word, he will praise it and add to it. A self-indulgent person heard it, and it displeased him; he cast it behind his back.
verses.display_text: If a knowledgeable person hears a wise word, he will praise it and add to it. A self-indulgent person heard it, and it displeased him; he cast it behind his back.

verses.text: A fool’s explanation is like a burden on a journey, but grace will be found on an understanding person’s lip.
verses.display_text: A fool’s explanation is like a burden on a journey, but grace will be found on an understanding person’s lip.

verses.text: The mouth of a prudent person will be sought in the assembly, and they will consider his words in their heart.
verses.display_text: The mouth of a prudent person will be sought in the assembly, and they will consider his words in their heart.

verses.text: Wisdom is like a ruined house to a fool, and an uncomprehending person’s knowledge is unexamined words.
verses.display_text: Wisdom is like a ruined house to a fool, and an uncomprehending person’s knowledge is unexamined words.

verses.text: Instruction is fetters on the feet of the senseless, and like handcuffs on his right hand.
verses.display_text: Instruction is fetters on the feet of the senseless, and like handcuffs on his right hand.

verses.text: A fool raises his voice in laughter, but a shrewd man will barely smile quietly.
verses.display_text: A fool raises his voice in laughter, but a shrewd man will barely smile quietly.

verses.text: Instruction is like a golden ornament to the prudent, and like a bracelet on his right arm.
verses.display_text: Instruction is like a golden ornament to the prudent, and like a bracelet on his right arm.

verses.text: A fool’s foot is quick to enter a house, but an experienced person will feel shame before it.
verses.display_text: A fool’s foot is quick to enter a house, but an experienced person will feel shame before it.

verses.text: A foolish person peers into a house from its door, but an instructed man will stand outside.
verses.display_text: A foolish person peers into a house from its door, but an instructed man will stand outside.

verses.text: It is a person’s lack of instruction to listen at a door, but the prudent will feel weighed down by the dishonor.
verses.display_text: It is a person’s lack of instruction to listen at a door, but the prudent will feel weighed down by the dishonor.

verses.text: Strangers’ lips will talk about these things, but the words of the prudent will be weighed in a balance.
verses.display_text: Strangers’ lips will talk about these things, but the words of the prudent will be weighed in a balance.

verses.text: Fools have their heart in their mouth, but the heart of the wise is their mouth.
verses.display_text: Fools have their heart in their mouth, but the heart of the wise is their mouth.

verses.text: When an ungodly person curses Satan, he curses his own soul.
verses.display_text: When an ungodly person curses Satan, he curses his own soul.

verses.text: The whisperer stains his own soul and will be hated where he dwells.
verses.display_text: The whisperer stains his own soul and will be hated where he dwells.

verses.text: A lazy person has been compared to a filthy stone, and everyone will hiss at his dishonor.
verses.display_text: A lazy person has been compared to a filthy stone, and everyone will hiss at his dishonor.

verses.text: A lazy person has been compared to a lump of dung; everyone who picks it up will shake his hand.
verses.display_text: A lazy person has been compared to a lump of dung; everyone who picks it up will shake his hand.

verses.text: A father’s shame is in begetting an uninstructed child, and a daughter brings about loss.
verses.display_text: A father’s shame is in begetting an uninstructed child, and a daughter brings about loss.

verses.text: A prudent daughter will inherit her husband, but one who brings shame brings grief to her parent.
verses.display_text: A prudent daughter will inherit her husband, but one who brings shame brings grief to her parent.

verses.text: A shameless woman shames both father and husband and will be dishonored by both.
verses.display_text: A shameless woman shames both father and husband and will be dishonored by both.

verses.text: An untimely discourse is music in mourning, but lashes and discipline are wisdom at every time.
verses.display_text: An untimely discourse is music in mourning, but lashes and discipline are wisdom at every time.

verses.text: The one teaching a fool is gluing a potsherd together, waking a sleeper from deep sleep.
verses.display_text: The one teaching a fool is gluing a potsherd together, waking a sleeper from deep sleep.

verses.text: The one speaking to a fool is speaking to someone drowsy; at the end he will say, “What is it?”
verses.display_text: The one speaking to a fool is speaking to someone drowsy; at the end he will say, “What is it?”

verses.text: Weep over a dead person, for he has lost the light; weep also over a fool, for he has lost understanding. Weep more gently over the dead, because he has found rest, but the fool’s life is worse than death.
verses.display_text: Weep over a dead person, for he has lost the light; weep also over a fool, for he has lost understanding. Weep more gently over the dead, because he has found rest, but the fool’s life is worse than death.

verses.text: Mourning for the dead lasts seven days; for a fool and an ungodly person, all the days of his life.
verses.display_text: Mourning for the dead lasts seven days; for a fool and an ungodly person, all the days of his life.

verses.text: Do not multiply words with a fool or go to someone without understanding. Guard against him so that you do not have trouble, and you will certainly not be stained by what he shakes off. Turn away from him, and you will find rest and will certainly not grow weary of his madness.
verses.display_text: Do not multiply words with a fool or go to someone without understanding. Guard against him so that you do not have trouble, and you will certainly not be stained by what he shakes off. Turn away from him, and you will find rest and will certainly not grow weary of his madness.

verses.text: What is heavier than lead? What is its name except a fool?
verses.display_text: What is heavier than lead? What is its name except a fool?

verses.text: Sand, salt, and a lump of iron are easier to bear than a person without understanding.
verses.display_text: Sand, salt, and a lump of iron are easier to bear than a person without understanding.

verses.text: A wooden bond fitted into a building will not be loosened in a shaking; so a heart established on thoughtful counsel will not be cowardly when the time comes.
verses.display_text: A wooden bond fitted into a building will not be loosened in a shaking; so a heart established on thoughtful counsel will not be cowardly when the time comes.

verses.text: A heart made firm upon an understanding thought is like a sanded ornament on a polished wall.
verses.display_text: A heart made firm upon an understanding thought is like a sanded ornament on a polished wall.

verses.text: Stakes set on a height will certainly not endure before the wind; so a cowardly heart resting on a foolish thought will certainly not endure before any fear.
verses.display_text: Stakes set on a height will certainly not endure before the wind; so a cowardly heart resting on a foolish thought will certainly not endure before any fear.

verses.text: The one who pricks an eye will bring down tears; the one who pricks a heart reveals feeling.
verses.display_text: The one who pricks an eye will bring down tears; the one who pricks a heart reveals feeling.

verses.text: Throwing a stone at birds drives them away, and the one who reproaches a friend will break up friendship.
verses.display_text: Throwing a stone at birds drives them away, and the one who reproaches a friend will break up friendship.

verses.text: If you draw a sword against a friend, do not despair, for there is a way back.
verses.display_text: If you draw a sword against a friend, do not despair, for there is a way back.

verses.text: If you open your mouth against a friend, do not be afraid, for there is reconciliation—except for reproach, pride, disclosure of a secret, and a treacherous blow; at these things every friend will flee.
verses.display_text: If you open your mouth against a friend, do not be afraid, for there is reconciliation—except for reproach, pride, disclosure of a secret, and a treacherous blow; at these things every friend will flee.

verses.text: Establish trust with your neighbor in poverty, so that you may be filled together with him in his good circumstances. Stay with him in a time of affliction, so that you may share his inheritance.
verses.display_text: Establish trust with your neighbor in poverty, so that you may be filled together with him in his good circumstances. Stay with him in a time of affliction, so that you may share his inheritance.

verses.text: Before fire come a furnace’s vapor and smoke; so before bloodshed come insults.
verses.display_text: Before fire come a furnace’s vapor and smoke; so before bloodshed come insults.

verses.text: I will not be ashamed to shelter a friend, and I will certainly not hide from his face.
verses.display_text: I will not be ashamed to shelter a friend, and I will certainly not hide from his face.

verses.text: If evil things happen to me because of him, everyone who hears will guard against him.
verses.display_text: If evil things happen to me because of him, everyone who hears will guard against him.

verses.text: Who will place a guard upon my mouth and a skillful seal upon my lips, so that I do not fall because of it and my tongue destroy me?
verses.display_text: Who will place a guard upon my mouth and a skillful seal upon my lips, so that I do not fall because of it and my tongue destroy me?

verses.text: Lord, Father and Master of my life, do not abandon me to their counsel; do not let me fall through them.
verses.display_text: Lord, Father and Master of my life, do not abandon me to their counsel; do not let me fall through them.

verses.text: Who will set lashes over my thought and wisdom’s discipline over my heart, so that they may not spare my errors of ignorance, and He may certainly not pass over their sins,
verses.display_text: Who will set lashes over my thought and wisdom’s discipline over my heart, so that they may not spare my errors of ignorance, and He may certainly not pass over their sins,

verses.text: so that my errors of ignorance do not multiply and my sins increase, and I fall before my adversaries and my enemy gloat over me?
verses.display_text: so that my errors of ignorance do not multiply and my sins increase, and I fall before my adversaries and my enemy gloat over me?

verses.text: Lord, Father and God of my life, do not give me haughty eyes,
verses.display_text: Lord, Father and God of my life, do not give me haughty eyes,

verses.text: and turn desire away from me.
verses.display_text: and turn desire away from me.

verses.text: Do not let the appetite of the belly and sexual intercourse overtake me, and do not hand me over to a shameless soul.
verses.display_text: Do not let the appetite of the belly and sexual intercourse overtake me, and do not hand me over to a shameless soul.

verses.text: Listen, children, to discipline of the mouth; the one who keeps it will certainly not be caught.
verses.display_text: Listen, children, to discipline of the mouth; the one who keeps it will certainly not be caught.

verses.text: A sinner will be caught by his lips, and an abusive person and a proud person will stumble through them.
verses.display_text: A sinner will be caught by his lips, and an abusive person and a proud person will stumble through them.

verses.text: Do not accustom your mouth to an oath, and do not make a habit of naming the Holy One.
verses.display_text: Do not accustom your mouth to an oath, and do not make a habit of naming the Holy One.

verses.text: For just as a household slave under continual examination will not be free of bruises, so the one who continually swears and invokes the name will certainly not be cleansed from sin.
verses.display_text: For just as a household slave under continual examination will not be free of bruises, so the one who continually swears and invokes the name will certainly not be cleansed from sin.

verses.text: A man of many oaths will be filled with lawlessness, and a scourge will not depart from his house. If he offends, his sin is upon him; if he disregards it, he has sinned twice. If he swore in vain, he will not be justified, for his house will be filled with calamities.
verses.display_text: A man of many oaths will be filled with lawlessness, and a scourge will not depart from his house. If he offends, his sin is upon him; if he disregards it, he has sinned twice. If he swore in vain, he will not be justified, for his house will be filled with calamities.

verses.text: There is an expression comparable to death; let it not be found in Jacob’s inheritance. For all these things will depart from the godly, and they will not wallow in sins.
verses.display_text: There is an expression comparable to death; let it not be found in Jacob’s inheritance. For all these things will depart from the godly, and they will not wallow in sins.

verses.text: Do not accustom your mouth to crude ignorance, for sinful speech is in it.
verses.display_text: Do not accustom your mouth to crude ignorance, for sinful speech is in it.

verses.text: Remember your father and mother, for you sit among dignitaries, lest you forget yourself before them and become foolish through your habit; then you will wish you had not been born and curse the day of your birth.
verses.display_text: Remember your father and mother, for you sit among dignitaries, lest you forget yourself before them and become foolish through your habit; then you will wish you had not been born and curse the day of your birth.

verses.text: A person accustomed to words of reproach will certainly not be instructed throughout all his days.
verses.display_text: A person accustomed to words of reproach will certainly not be instructed throughout all his days.

verses.text: Two kinds multiply sins, and the third will bring wrath:
verses.display_text: Two kinds multiply sins, and the third will bring wrath:

verses.text: a heated soul, like a burning fire, will certainly not be quenched until it is consumed; a sexually immoral man in his fleshly body will certainly not stop until he kindles a fire. Every loaf is sweet to a sexually immoral man; he will certainly not cease until he dies.
verses.display_text: a heated soul, like a burning fire, will certainly not be quenched until it is consumed; a sexually immoral man in his fleshly body will certainly not stop until he kindles a fire. Every loaf is sweet to a sexually immoral man; he will certainly not cease until he dies.

verses.text: A man who transgresses from his marriage bed says in his soul, “Who sees me? Darkness is around me, and the walls cover me; no one sees me. What should I fear? The Most High will certainly not remember my sins.”
verses.display_text: A man who transgresses from his marriage bed says in his soul, “Who sees me? Darkness is around me, and the walls cover me; no one sees me. What should I fear? The Most High will certainly not remember my sins.”

verses.text: Human eyes are what he fears; he does not know that the Lord’s eyes are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, surveying every human way and observing hidden places.
verses.display_text: Human eyes are what he fears; he does not know that the Lord’s eyes are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, surveying every human way and observing hidden places.

verses.text: Before all things were created, they were known to Him, and likewise after they were completed.
verses.display_text: Before all things were created, they were known to Him, and likewise after they were completed.

verses.text: This man will receive retribution in the city’s squares and be seized where he did not suspect it.
verses.display_text: This man will receive retribution in the city’s squares and be seized where he did not suspect it.

verses.text: So also a woman who leaves her husband and presents an heir from another man.
verses.display_text: So also a woman who leaves her husband and presents an heir from another man.

verses.text: For first she disobeyed the law of the Most High; second she wronged her husband; and third she committed adultery in sexual immorality and presented children from another man.
verses.display_text: For first she disobeyed the law of the Most High; second she wronged her husband; and third she committed adultery in sexual immorality and presented children from another man.

verses.text: She will be brought before the assembly, and there will be a visitation upon her children.
verses.display_text: She will be brought before the assembly, and there will be a visitation upon her children.

verses.text: Her children will not spread out into a root, and her branches will not bear fruit.
verses.display_text: Her children will not spread out into a root, and her branches will not bear fruit.

verses.text: She will leave her memory as a curse, and her reproach will not be erased.
verses.display_text: She will leave her memory as a curse, and her reproach will not be erased.

verses.text: Those left behind will know that nothing is better than the fear of the Lord, and nothing sweeter than attending to the Lord’s commandments.
verses.display_text: Those left behind will know that nothing is better than the fear of the Lord, and nothing sweeter than attending to the Lord’s commandments.

verses.text: Wisdom will praise her own soul and boast in the midst of her people.
verses.display_text: Wisdom will praise her own soul and boast in the midst of her people.

verses.text: She will open her mouth in the assembly of the Most High and boast before His host:
verses.display_text: She will open her mouth in the assembly of the Most High and boast before His host:

verses.text: “I came forth from the mouth of the Most High and covered the earth like mist.
verses.display_text: “I came forth from the mouth of the Most High and covered the earth like mist.

verses.text: I dwelt in the heights, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud.
verses.display_text: I dwelt in the heights, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud.

verses.text: Alone I encircled heaven’s circuit and walked in the depth of the abysses.
verses.display_text: Alone I encircled heaven’s circuit and walked in the depth of the abysses.

verses.text: In the waves of the sea, in all the earth, and in every people and nation I gained possession.
verses.display_text: In the waves of the sea, in all the earth, and in every people and nation I gained possession.

verses.text: Among all these I sought rest, and in whose inheritance I might lodge.
verses.display_text: Among all these I sought rest, and in whose inheritance I might lodge.

verses.text: Then the Creator of all commanded me; my Creator settled my tent and said, ‘Dwell in Jacob, and receive your inheritance in Israel.’
verses.display_text: Then the Creator of all commanded me; my Creator settled my tent and said, ‘Dwell in Jacob, and receive your inheritance in Israel.’

verses.text: Before the age, from the beginning, He created me, and for ever I will certainly not cease.
verses.display_text: Before the age, from the beginning, He created me, and for ever I will certainly not cease.

verses.text: I ministered before Him in the holy tent, and thus I was established in Zion.
verses.display_text: I ministered before Him in the holy tent, and thus I was established in Zion.

verses.text: Likewise He settled me in the beloved city, and my authority was in Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: Likewise He settled me in the beloved city, and my authority was in Jerusalem.

verses.text: I took root in a glorified people, in the Lord’s portion, His inheritance.
verses.display_text: I took root in a glorified people, in the Lord’s portion, His inheritance.

verses.text: I rose high like a cedar in Lebanon, like a cypress in the mountains of Hermon.
verses.display_text: I rose high like a cedar in Lebanon, like a cypress in the mountains of Hermon.

verses.text: I rose high like a palm in En-gedi, like rose plants in Jericho, like a stately olive in the plain; I rose high like a plane tree.
verses.display_text: I rose high like a palm in En-gedi, like rose plants in Jericho, like a stately olive in the plain; I rose high like a plane tree.

verses.text: Like cinnamon and aromatic aspalathus I gave a scent; like choice myrrh I spread fragrance, like galbanum, onycha, and stacte, and like a cloud of frankincense in a tent.
verses.display_text: Like cinnamon and aromatic aspalathus I gave a scent; like choice myrrh I spread fragrance, like galbanum, onycha, and stacte, and like a cloud of frankincense in a tent.

verses.text: Like a terebinth I spread out my branches, and my branches were branches of glory and grace.
verses.display_text: Like a terebinth I spread out my branches, and my branches were branches of glory and grace.

verses.text: Like a vine I sprouted grace, and my blossoms were fruit of glory and wealth.
verses.display_text: Like a vine I sprouted grace, and my blossoms were fruit of glory and wealth.

verses.text: Come to me, you who desire me, and be filled from my produce.
verses.display_text: Come to me, you who desire me, and be filled from my produce.

verses.text: For my memory is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than a honeycomb.
verses.display_text: For my memory is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than a honeycomb.

verses.text: Those who eat me will still hunger, and those who drink me will still thirst.
verses.display_text: Those who eat me will still hunger, and those who drink me will still thirst.

verses.text: The one who obeys me will not be ashamed, and those who work in me will not sin.”
verses.display_text: The one who obeys me will not be ashamed, and those who work in me will not sin.”

verses.text: All these things are the book of the covenant of God Most High, the law which Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob,
verses.display_text: All these things are the book of the covenant of God Most High, the law which Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob,

verses.text: which fills with wisdom like the Pishon, like the Tigris in the days of new crops,
verses.display_text: which fills with wisdom like the Pishon, like the Tigris in the days of new crops,

verses.text: which fills with understanding like the Euphrates, like the Jordan in the days of harvest,
verses.display_text: which fills with understanding like the Euphrates, like the Jordan in the days of harvest,
