verses.text: which makes instruction appear like light, like the Gihon in the days of vintage.
verses.display_text: which makes instruction appear like light, like the Gihon in the days of vintage.

verses.text: The first did not come to know her fully, and likewise the last did not trace her out.
verses.display_text: The first did not come to know her fully, and likewise the last did not trace her out.

verses.text: For her thought grew abundant from the sea, and her counsel from a great abyss.
verses.display_text: For her thought grew abundant from the sea, and her counsel from a great abyss.

verses.text: I too came out like a channel from a river, like a watercourse into a garden.
verses.display_text: I too came out like a channel from a river, like a watercourse into a garden.

verses.text: I said, “I will water my garden and drench my garden bed.” Then behold, my channel became a river, and my river became a sea.
verses.display_text: I said, “I will water my garden and drench my garden bed.” Then behold, my channel became a river, and my river became a sea.

verses.text: I will again make instruction shine like the dawn and reveal these things far away.
verses.display_text: I will again make instruction shine like the dawn and reveal these things far away.

verses.text: I will again pour out teaching like prophecy and leave it for generations of ages.
verses.display_text: I will again pour out teaching like prophecy and leave it for generations of ages.

verses.text: See that I have labored not for myself alone, but for all who seek her.
verses.display_text: See that I have labored not for myself alone, but for all who seek her.

verses.text: In three things I was adorned and stood beautiful before the Lord and human beings: harmony among brothers, friendship among neighbors, and a wife and husband living agreeably with one another.
verses.display_text: In three things I was adorned and stood beautiful before the Lord and human beings: harmony among brothers, friendship among neighbors, and a wife and husband living agreeably with one another.

verses.text: But my soul hated three kinds, and I was greatly offended at their life: a proud poor person, a rich liar, and an old adulterer deficient in understanding.
verses.display_text: But my soul hated three kinds, and I was greatly offended at their life: a proud poor person, a rich liar, and an old adulterer deficient in understanding.

verses.text: You have not gathered in youth; how could you find anything in your old age?
verses.display_text: You have not gathered in youth; how could you find anything in your old age?

verses.text: How fitting is judgment for gray hair, and knowledge of counsel for elders!
verses.display_text: How fitting is judgment for gray hair, and knowledge of counsel for elders!

verses.text: How fitting is wisdom for the old, and thought and counsel for the honored!
verses.display_text: How fitting is wisdom for the old, and thought and counsel for the honored!

verses.text: Long experience is the crown of the old, and their boast is the fear of the Lord.
verses.display_text: Long experience is the crown of the old, and their boast is the fear of the Lord.

verses.text: Nine things I considered happy in my heart, and the tenth I will speak with my tongue: a person rejoicing in children, one who lives to see his enemies’ fall;
verses.display_text: Nine things I considered happy in my heart, and the tenth I will speak with my tongue: a person rejoicing in children, one who lives to see his enemies’ fall;

verses.text: happy is the one who lives with an understanding wife, who has not slipped with his tongue, and who has not served someone unworthy of him;
verses.display_text: happy is the one who lives with an understanding wife, who has not slipped with his tongue, and who has not served someone unworthy of him;

verses.text: happy is the one who has found prudence and the one who speaks into listening ears.
verses.display_text: happy is the one who has found prudence and the one who speaks into listening ears.

verses.text: How great is the one who has found wisdom! Yet he is not above the one who fears the Lord.
verses.display_text: How great is the one who has found wisdom! Yet he is not above the one who fears the Lord.

verses.text: The fear of the Lord has surpassed everything; to whom will the one who holds it fast be compared?
verses.display_text: The fear of the Lord has surpassed everything; to whom will the one who holds it fast be compared?

verses.text: Any wound, but not a wound of the heart; any evil, but not a woman’s evil;
verses.display_text: Any wound, but not a wound of the heart; any evil, but not a woman’s evil;

verses.text: any calamity, but not a calamity from those who hate; any retribution, but not the retribution of enemies.
verses.display_text: any calamity, but not a calamity from those who hate; any retribution, but not the retribution of enemies.

verses.text: There is no head beyond a snake’s head, and no anger beyond an enemy’s anger.
verses.display_text: There is no head beyond a snake’s head, and no anger beyond an enemy’s anger.

verses.text: I would choose to live with a lion and a dragon rather than live with an evil woman.
verses.display_text: I would choose to live with a lion and a dragon rather than live with an evil woman.

verses.text: A woman’s evil changes her appearance and darkens her face like a bear.
verses.display_text: A woman’s evil changes her appearance and darkens her face like a bear.

verses.text: Her husband will recline among his neighbors and involuntarily groan bitterly.
verses.display_text: Her husband will recline among his neighbors and involuntarily groan bitterly.

verses.text: Every evil is small beside a woman’s evil; may a sinner’s lot fall upon her.
verses.display_text: Every evil is small beside a woman’s evil; may a sinner’s lot fall upon her.

verses.text: A sandy ascent under an old person’s feet—so is a talkative wife to a quiet husband.
verses.display_text: A sandy ascent under an old person’s feet—so is a talkative wife to a quiet husband.

verses.text: Do not fall for a woman’s beauty, and do not long for a woman.
verses.display_text: Do not fall for a woman’s beauty, and do not long for a woman.

verses.text: Wrath, shamelessness, and great shame result if a wife supplies her husband.
verses.display_text: Wrath, shamelessness, and great shame result if a wife supplies her husband.

verses.text: An evil wife is a humbled heart, a gloomy face, and a wound of the heart; one who will not make her husband happy is slack hands and paralyzed knees.
verses.display_text: An evil wife is a humbled heart, a gloomy face, and a wound of the heart; one who will not make her husband happy is slack hands and paralyzed knees.

verses.text: From a woman came the beginning of sin, and because of her we all die.
verses.display_text: From a woman came the beginning of sin, and because of her we all die.

verses.text: Do not give water an outlet, or an evil wife freedom of speech.
verses.display_text: Do not give water an outlet, or an evil wife freedom of speech.

verses.text: If she does not walk according to your direction, cut her off from your flesh.
verses.display_text: If she does not walk according to your direction, cut her off from your flesh.

verses.text: Happy is the husband of a good wife, and the number of his days is doubled.
verses.display_text: Happy is the husband of a good wife, and the number of his days is doubled.

verses.text: A courageous wife gladdens her husband, and he will complete his years in peace.
verses.display_text: A courageous wife gladdens her husband, and he will complete his years in peace.

verses.text: A good wife is a good portion; she will be given among the portion of those who fear the Lord.
verses.display_text: A good wife is a good portion; she will be given among the portion of those who fear the Lord.

verses.text: Whether rich or poor, his heart is good, and at every time his face is cheerful.
verses.display_text: Whether rich or poor, his heart is good, and at every time his face is cheerful.

verses.text: My heart feared three things, and before a fourth presence I made supplication: a city’s slander, an assembled mob, and a false accusation—all more grievous than death.
verses.display_text: My heart feared three things, and before a fourth presence I made supplication: a city’s slander, an assembled mob, and a false accusation—all more grievous than death.

verses.text: A wife jealous of another wife is heartache and mourning, and a scourge of the tongue that reaches everyone.
verses.display_text: A wife jealous of another wife is heartache and mourning, and a scourge of the tongue that reaches everyone.

verses.text: An evil wife is a shifting ox-yoke; the one who takes hold of her is like someone grasping a scorpion.
verses.display_text: An evil wife is a shifting ox-yoke; the one who takes hold of her is like someone grasping a scorpion.

verses.text: A drunken wife is great wrath, and she will not conceal her shame.
verses.display_text: A drunken wife is great wrath, and she will not conceal her shame.

verses.text: A woman’s sexual immorality will be known in the lifting of her eyes and in her eyelids.
verses.display_text: A woman’s sexual immorality will be known in the lifting of her eyes and in her eyelids.

verses.text: Keep a firm watch over a headstrong daughter, so that she does not find freedom and use it for herself.
verses.display_text: Keep a firm watch over a headstrong daughter, so that she does not find freedom and use it for herself.

verses.text: Be on guard after a shameless eye, and do not marvel if she offends against you.
verses.display_text: Be on guard after a shameless eye, and do not marvel if she offends against you.

verses.text: Like a thirsty traveler she will open her mouth and drink from every nearby water; she will sit before every tent peg and open her quiver before an arrow.
verses.display_text: Like a thirsty traveler she will open her mouth and drink from every nearby water; she will sit before every tent peg and open her quiver before an arrow.

verses.text: A wife’s grace will delight her husband, and her knowledge will fatten his bones.
verses.display_text: A wife’s grace will delight her husband, and her knowledge will fatten his bones.

verses.text: A silent wife is a gift of the Lord, and there is no exchange for a disciplined soul.
verses.display_text: A silent wife is a gift of the Lord, and there is no exchange for a disciplined soul.

verses.text: A modest wife is grace upon grace, and no weight is worth a self-controlled soul.
verses.display_text: A modest wife is grace upon grace, and no weight is worth a self-controlled soul.

verses.text: The sun rising in the Lord’s heights—so is a good wife’s beauty in the order of her house.
verses.display_text: The sun rising in the Lord’s heights—so is a good wife’s beauty in the order of her house.

verses.text: A lamp shining upon a holy lampstand—so is a beautiful face upon a firmly established stature.
verses.display_text: A lamp shining upon a holy lampstand—so is a beautiful face upon a firmly established stature.

verses.text: Golden pillars upon a silver base—so are beautiful feet upon the breast of one who stands firm.
verses.display_text: Golden pillars upon a silver base—so are beautiful feet upon the breast of one who stands firm.

verses.text: At two things my heart has grieved, and at the third anger came upon me: a warrior in want through need, understanding men when they are treated as refuse, and someone turning back from righteousness to sin. The Lord will prepare him for the sword.
verses.display_text: At two things my heart has grieved, and at the third anger came upon me: a warrior in want through need, understanding men when they are treated as refuse, and someone turning back from righteousness to sin. The Lord will prepare him for the sword.

verses.text: A merchant will hardly be delivered from wrongdoing, and a retailer will not be acquitted of sin.
verses.display_text: A merchant will hardly be delivered from wrongdoing, and a retailer will not be acquitted of sin.

verses.text: Many have sinned for profit, and the one who seeks to increase his gains will turn his eye away.
verses.display_text: Many have sinned for profit, and the one who seeks to increase his gains will turn his eye away.

verses.text: A peg will be fixed between the joints of stones, and sin will be squeezed between selling and buying.
verses.display_text: A peg will be fixed between the joints of stones, and sin will be squeezed between selling and buying.

verses.text: Unless a person holds fast diligently in the fear of the Lord, his house will quickly be overthrown.
verses.display_text: Unless a person holds fast diligently in the fear of the Lord, his house will quickly be overthrown.

verses.text: When a sieve is shaken, refuse remains; so a person’s rubbish remains in his reasoning.
verses.display_text: When a sieve is shaken, refuse remains; so a person’s rubbish remains in his reasoning.

verses.text: A furnace tests a potter’s vessels, and a person’s testing is in his deliberation.
verses.display_text: A furnace tests a potter’s vessels, and a person’s testing is in his deliberation.

verses.text: A tree’s fruit reveals its cultivation; so a word reveals the thought of a person’s heart.
verses.display_text: A tree’s fruit reveals its cultivation; so a word reveals the thought of a person’s heart.

verses.text: Do not praise a man before he reasons, for this is the testing of human beings.
verses.display_text: Do not praise a man before he reasons, for this is the testing of human beings.

verses.text: If you pursue what is right, you will attain it and put it on like a glorious robe reaching to the feet.
verses.display_text: If you pursue what is right, you will attain it and put it on like a glorious robe reaching to the feet.

verses.text: Birds will lodge with their like, and truth will return to those who practice it.
verses.display_text: Birds will lodge with their like, and truth will return to those who practice it.

verses.text: A lion lies in wait for prey; so sin lies in wait for those who do unjust things.
verses.display_text: A lion lies in wait for prey; so sin lies in wait for those who do unjust things.

verses.text: A godly person’s discourse is always wisdom, but a fool changes like the moon.
verses.display_text: A godly person’s discourse is always wisdom, but a fool changes like the moon.

verses.text: Among people without understanding, watch the time; among thoughtful people, linger.
verses.display_text: Among people without understanding, watch the time; among thoughtful people, linger.

verses.text: Fools’ discourse is offensive, and their laughter is in sinful indulgence.
verses.display_text: Fools’ discourse is offensive, and their laughter is in sinful indulgence.

verses.text: The talk of someone who swears many oaths will make hair stand up, and their quarrel makes one stop the ears.
verses.display_text: The talk of someone who swears many oaths will make hair stand up, and their quarrel makes one stop the ears.

verses.text: The quarrel of the proud is bloodshed, and their mutual abuse is grievous to hear.
verses.display_text: The quarrel of the proud is bloodshed, and their mutual abuse is grievous to hear.

verses.text: The one who reveals secrets has destroyed trust and will certainly not find a friend close to his soul.
verses.display_text: The one who reveals secrets has destroyed trust and will certainly not find a friend close to his soul.

verses.text: Love a friend and keep faith with him; but if you reveal his secrets, do not pursue him afterward.
verses.display_text: Love a friend and keep faith with him; but if you reveal his secrets, do not pursue him afterward.

verses.text: For as a person has lost his dead, so you have lost your neighbor’s friendship.
verses.display_text: For as a person has lost his dead, so you have lost your neighbor’s friendship.

verses.text: As you have released a bird from your hand, so you have let your neighbor go, and you will not catch him.
verses.display_text: As you have released a bird from your hand, so you have let your neighbor go, and you will not catch him.

verses.text: Do not pursue him, because he has gone far away and escaped like a gazelle from a trap.
verses.display_text: Do not pursue him, because he has gone far away and escaped like a gazelle from a trap.

verses.text: For a wound can be bound up, and there is reconciliation after abuse, but the one who revealed secrets has lost hope.
verses.display_text: For a wound can be bound up, and there is reconciliation after abuse, but the one who revealed secrets has lost hope.

verses.text: The one who winks with his eye devises evil things, and no one will remove them from him.
verses.display_text: The one who winks with his eye devises evil things, and no one will remove them from him.

verses.text: Before your eyes he will make his mouth sweet and marvel at your words, but afterward he will twist his mouth and put a stumbling block in your words.
verses.display_text: Before your eyes he will make his mouth sweet and marvel at your words, but afterward he will twist his mouth and put a stumbling block in your words.

verses.text: I have hated many things, but compared none to him; the Lord will hate him too.
verses.display_text: I have hated many things, but compared none to him; the Lord will hate him too.

verses.text: The one who throws a stone upward throws it upon his own head, and a treacherous blow will open wounds.
verses.display_text: The one who throws a stone upward throws it upon his own head, and a treacherous blow will open wounds.

verses.text: The one who digs a pit will fall into it, and the one who sets a trap will be caught in it.
verses.display_text: The one who digs a pit will fall into it, and the one who sets a trap will be caught in it.

verses.text: The one who does evil things will have them roll back upon him, and he will certainly not know where they have come to him from.
verses.display_text: The one who does evil things will have them roll back upon him, and he will certainly not know where they have come to him from.

verses.text: Mockery and reproach await the proud, and retribution will lie in wait for him like a lion.
verses.display_text: Mockery and reproach await the proud, and retribution will lie in wait for him like a lion.

verses.text: Those who rejoice at the fall of the godly will be caught in a trap, and pain will consume them before their death.
verses.display_text: Those who rejoice at the fall of the godly will be caught in a trap, and pain will consume them before their death.

verses.text: Resentment and wrath—these too are abominations, and a sinful man will hold them fast.
verses.display_text: Resentment and wrath—these too are abominations, and a sinful man will hold them fast.

verses.text: The one who takes revenge will find revenge from the Lord, and He will certainly keep his sins in view.
verses.display_text: The one who takes revenge will find revenge from the Lord, and He will certainly keep his sins in view.

verses.text: Forgive your neighbor’s wrong, and then when you pray, your sins will be released.
verses.display_text: Forgive your neighbor’s wrong, and then when you pray, your sins will be released.

verses.text: Does a person keep wrath against another person and seek healing from the Lord?
verses.display_text: Does a person keep wrath against another person and seek healing from the Lord?

verses.text: Does he have no mercy on a person like himself and pray concerning his own sins?
verses.display_text: Does he have no mercy on a person like himself and pray concerning his own sins?

verses.text: If he himself, being flesh, keeps resentment, who will atone for his sins?
verses.display_text: If he himself, being flesh, keeps resentment, who will atone for his sins?

verses.text: Remember the last things and stop being hostile; remember decay and death, and remain in the commandments.
verses.display_text: Remember the last things and stop being hostile; remember decay and death, and remain in the commandments.

verses.text: Remember the commandments and do not be resentful toward your neighbor; remember the covenant of the Most High and overlook ignorance.
verses.display_text: Remember the commandments and do not be resentful toward your neighbor; remember the covenant of the Most High and overlook ignorance.

verses.text: Keep away from quarrelling, and you will lessen sins, for a hot-tempered person will kindle a quarrel.
verses.display_text: Keep away from quarrelling, and you will lessen sins, for a hot-tempered person will kindle a quarrel.

verses.text: A sinful man will disturb friends and cast slander among those at peace.
verses.display_text: A sinful man will disturb friends and cast slander among those at peace.

verses.text: As the fuel for a fire is, so it will burn; as a quarrel grows firm, so it will burn. A person’s anger will match his strength, and he will raise his wrath according to his wealth.
verses.display_text: As the fuel for a fire is, so it will burn; as a quarrel grows firm, so it will burn. A person’s anger will match his strength, and he will raise his wrath according to his wealth.

verses.text: A hurried dispute kindles fire, and a rushing quarrel pours out blood.
verses.display_text: A hurried dispute kindles fire, and a rushing quarrel pours out blood.

verses.text: If you blow on a spark, it will burn; if you spit on it, it will be quenched. Both come out of your mouth.
verses.display_text: If you blow on a spark, it will burn; if you spit on it, it will be quenched. Both come out of your mouth.

verses.text: Curse a whisperer and someone double-tongued, for he has destroyed many who were at peace.
verses.display_text: Curse a whisperer and someone double-tongued, for he has destroyed many who were at peace.

verses.text: A third tongue has shaken many and scattered them from nation to nation; it has pulled down fortified cities and overthrown dignitaries’ houses.
verses.display_text: A third tongue has shaken many and scattered them from nation to nation; it has pulled down fortified cities and overthrown dignitaries’ houses.

verses.text: A third tongue has driven out courageous women and deprived them of their labors.
verses.display_text: A third tongue has driven out courageous women and deprived them of their labors.

verses.text: The one who attends to it will certainly not find rest or dwell in quiet.
verses.display_text: The one who attends to it will certainly not find rest or dwell in quiet.

verses.text: A lash’s blow makes a bruise, but a tongue’s blow will shatter bones.
verses.display_text: A lash’s blow makes a bruise, but a tongue’s blow will shatter bones.

verses.text: Many have fallen by the edge of a sword, yet not as many as those who have fallen through a tongue.
verses.display_text: Many have fallen by the edge of a sword, yet not as many as those who have fallen through a tongue.

verses.text: Happy is the one sheltered from it, who has not passed through its anger, who has not pulled its yoke or been bound in its bonds.
verses.display_text: Happy is the one sheltered from it, who has not passed through its anger, who has not pulled its yoke or been bound in its bonds.

verses.text: For its yoke is an iron yoke, and its bonds are bronze bonds.
verses.display_text: For its yoke is an iron yoke, and its bonds are bronze bonds.

verses.text: The death it brings is an evil death, and Hades is preferable to it.
verses.display_text: The death it brings is an evil death, and Hades is preferable to it.

verses.text: It will certainly not master the godly, and they will not be burned in its flame.
verses.display_text: It will certainly not master the godly, and they will not be burned in its flame.

verses.text: Those who abandon the Lord will fall into it; among them it will burn and certainly not be quenched. It will be sent against them like a lion and ravage them like a leopard.
verses.display_text: Those who abandon the Lord will fall into it; among them it will burn and certainly not be quenched. It will be sent against them like a lion and ravage them like a leopard.

verses.text: Behold, fence your property with thorns; bind up your silver and gold.
verses.display_text: Behold, fence your property with thorns; bind up your silver and gold.

verses.text: Make a balance and a weight for your words, and make a door and a bar for your mouth.
verses.display_text: Make a balance and a weight for your words, and make a door and a bar for your mouth.

verses.text: Take care lest you slip through it, lest you fall before someone lying in ambush.
verses.display_text: Take care lest you slip through it, lest you fall before someone lying in ambush.

verses.text: The one who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor, and the one who strengthens his hand keeps commandments.
verses.display_text: The one who shows mercy will lend to his neighbor, and the one who strengthens his hand keeps commandments.

verses.text: Lend to your neighbor at his time of need, and in turn repay your neighbor at the appointed time.
verses.display_text: Lend to your neighbor at his time of need, and in turn repay your neighbor at the appointed time.

verses.text: Confirm your word and keep faith with him, and at every time you will find what you need.
verses.display_text: Confirm your word and keep faith with him, and at every time you will find what you need.

verses.text: Many regarded a loan as a windfall and brought trouble upon those who helped them.
verses.display_text: Many regarded a loan as a windfall and brought trouble upon those who helped them.

verses.text: Until he receives it, he will kiss the lender’s hands and lower his voice over his neighbor’s money; when repayment is due, he will drag out the time, return words of indifference, and blame the season.
verses.display_text: Until he receives it, he will kiss the lender’s hands and lower his voice over his neighbor’s money; when repayment is due, he will drag out the time, return words of indifference, and blame the season.

verses.text: If the lender succeeds, he will scarcely recover half and regard it as a windfall. If not, the borrower has deprived him of his money and made him an enemy for nothing. He will repay him with curses and insults, and repay dishonor in place of honor.
verses.display_text: If the lender succeeds, he will scarcely recover half and regard it as a windfall. If not, the borrower has deprived him of his money and made him an enemy for nothing. He will repay him with curses and insults, and repay dishonor in place of honor.

verses.text: Many have turned away, not from wickedness, but because they feared being deprived for nothing.
verses.display_text: Many have turned away, not from wickedness, but because they feared being deprived for nothing.

verses.text: Nevertheless, be patient with the lowly person and do not keep him waiting for alms.
verses.display_text: Nevertheless, be patient with the lowly person and do not keep him waiting for alms.

verses.text: For the commandment’s sake, support the poor person; in his need do not turn him away empty.
verses.display_text: For the commandment’s sake, support the poor person; in his need do not turn him away empty.

verses.text: Lose silver for a brother and a friend, and do not let it corrode under a stone to destruction.
verses.display_text: Lose silver for a brother and a friend, and do not let it corrode under a stone to destruction.

verses.text: Place your treasure according to the Most High’s commandments, and it will benefit you more than gold.
verses.display_text: Place your treasure according to the Most High’s commandments, and it will benefit you more than gold.

verses.text: Store up almsgiving in your chambers, and it will rescue you from every affliction.
verses.display_text: Store up almsgiving in your chambers, and it will rescue you from every affliction.

verses.text: More than a strong shield and more than a weighty spear, it will fight for you against an enemy.
verses.display_text: More than a strong shield and more than a weighty spear, it will fight for you against an enemy.

verses.text: A good man will stand surety for his neighbor, but someone who has lost shame will abandon him.
verses.display_text: A good man will stand surety for his neighbor, but someone who has lost shame will abandon him.

verses.text: Do not forget a guarantor’s favors, for he has given his life on your behalf.
verses.display_text: Do not forget a guarantor’s favors, for he has given his life on your behalf.

verses.text: A sinner will overthrow a guarantor’s good circumstances, and someone ungrateful in thought will abandon his rescuer.
verses.display_text: A sinner will overthrow a guarantor’s good circumstances, and someone ungrateful in thought will abandon his rescuer.

verses.text: Surety has destroyed many who were prospering and shaken them like a wave of the sea.
verses.display_text: Surety has destroyed many who were prospering and shaken them like a wave of the sea.

verses.text: It has driven powerful men from home, and they wandered among foreign nations.
verses.display_text: It has driven powerful men from home, and they wandered among foreign nations.

verses.text: A sinner who falls into surety and pursues profitable undertakings will fall into lawsuits.
verses.display_text: A sinner who falls into surety and pursues profitable undertakings will fall into lawsuits.

verses.text: Support your neighbor according to your ability, and take care of yourself so that you do not fall.
verses.display_text: Support your neighbor according to your ability, and take care of yourself so that you do not fall.

verses.text: The first necessities of life are water, bread, clothing, and a house that covers nakedness.
verses.display_text: The first necessities of life are water, bread, clothing, and a house that covers nakedness.

verses.text: Better a poor person’s life beneath a shelter of beams than splendid dishes in other people’s homes.
verses.display_text: Better a poor person’s life beneath a shelter of beams than splendid dishes in other people’s homes.

verses.text: Be content with little or much, and you will certainly not hear the reproach of living as a guest.
verses.display_text: Be content with little or much, and you will certainly not hear the reproach of living as a guest.

verses.text: A life from house to house is grievous; where you live as a guest, you will not open your mouth.
verses.display_text: A life from house to house is grievous; where you live as a guest, you will not open your mouth.

verses.text: You will entertain and provide drink without thanks, and besides these things you will hear bitter words:
verses.display_text: You will entertain and provide drink without thanks, and besides these things you will hear bitter words:

verses.text: “Come along, guest, arrange the table, and if you have anything in your hand, feed me.
verses.display_text: “Come along, guest, arrange the table, and if you have anything in your hand, feed me.

verses.text: Go out, guest, before a more honored person; my brother has come as my guest, and I need the house.”
verses.display_text: Go out, guest, before a more honored person; my brother has come as my guest, and I need the house.”

verses.text: These things are burdensome to a person with prudence: rebuke about lodging and a creditor’s reproach.
verses.display_text: These things are burdensome to a person with prudence: rebuke about lodging and a creditor’s reproach.

verses.text: The one who loves his son will continually give him lashes, so that he may rejoice at his last days.
verses.display_text: The one who loves his son will continually give him lashes, so that he may rejoice at his last days.

verses.text: The one who disciplines his son will benefit from him and boast about him among acquaintances.
verses.display_text: The one who disciplines his son will benefit from him and boast about him among acquaintances.

verses.text: The one who teaches his son will make his enemy envious and rejoice over him before friends.
verses.display_text: The one who teaches his son will make his enemy envious and rejoice over him before friends.

verses.text: His father died, yet it is as though he did not die, for he left someone like himself after him.
verses.display_text: His father died, yet it is as though he did not die, for he left someone like himself after him.

verses.text: During his life he saw him and rejoiced, and at his death he was not grieved.
verses.display_text: During his life he saw him and rejoiced, and at his death he was not grieved.

verses.text: He left an avenger against enemies and one who would repay kindness to friends.
verses.display_text: He left an avenger against enemies and one who would repay kindness to friends.

verses.text: The one who pampers a son will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.
verses.display_text: The one who pampers a son will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.

verses.text: An untamed horse turns out stubborn, and an unrestrained son turns out headstrong.
verses.display_text: An untamed horse turns out stubborn, and an unrestrained son turns out headstrong.

verses.text: Pamper a child, and he will terrify you; play with him, and he will grieve you.
verses.display_text: Pamper a child, and he will terrify you; play with him, and he will grieve you.

verses.text: Do not laugh together with him, so that you do not suffer together and in the end gnash your teeth.
verses.display_text: Do not laugh together with him, so that you do not suffer together and in the end gnash your teeth.

verses.text: Do not give him authority in youth.
verses.display_text: Do not give him authority in youth.

verses.text: Bruise his sides while he is little, lest he become hardened and disobey you.
verses.display_text: Bruise his sides while he is little, lest he become hardened and disobey you.

verses.text: Discipline your son and work upon him, so that you do not stumble through his shamelessness.
verses.display_text: Discipline your son and work upon him, so that you do not stumble through his shamelessness.

verses.text: Better a poor person who is healthy and strong in constitution than a rich person scourged in his body.
verses.display_text: Better a poor person who is healthy and strong in constitution than a rich person scourged in his body.

verses.text: Health and soundness are better than all gold, and a robust body than immeasurable wealth.
verses.display_text: Health and soundness are better than all gold, and a robust body than immeasurable wealth.

verses.text: There is no wealth better than bodily health, and no gladness beyond joy of heart.
verses.display_text: There is no wealth better than bodily health, and no gladness beyond joy of heart.

verses.text: Death is better than a bitter life, and eternal rest than persistent illness.
verses.display_text: Death is better than a bitter life, and eternal rest than persistent illness.

verses.text: Good things poured out before a closed mouth are like offerings of food set beside a tomb.
verses.display_text: Good things poured out before a closed mouth are like offerings of food set beside a tomb.

verses.text: What benefit is an offering to an idol? For it neither eats nor smells; so is the one pursued by the Lord.
verses.display_text: What benefit is an offering to an idol? For it neither eats nor smells; so is the one pursued by the Lord.

verses.text: He sees with his eyes and groans, like a eunuch embracing a virgin and groaning.
verses.display_text: He sees with his eyes and groans, like a eunuch embracing a virgin and groaning.

verses.text: Do not give your soul over to grief, and do not afflict yourself with your deliberation.
verses.display_text: Do not give your soul over to grief, and do not afflict yourself with your deliberation.

verses.text: Gladness of heart is a person’s life, and a man’s rejoicing is length of days.
verses.display_text: Gladness of heart is a person’s life, and a man’s rejoicing is length of days.

verses.text: Beguile your soul, comfort your heart, and put grief far from you; for grief has destroyed many, and there is no benefit in it.
verses.display_text: Beguile your soul, comfort your heart, and put grief far from you; for grief has destroyed many, and there is no benefit in it.

verses.text: Jealousy and anger shorten days, and anxiety brings old age before its time.
verses.display_text: Jealousy and anger shorten days, and anxiety brings old age before its time.

verses.text: A bright and good heart will take care over the dishes it eats.
verses.display_text: A bright and good heart will take care over the dishes it eats.

verses.text: Wakefulness over wealth wastes the flesh, and anxiety about it drives away sleep.
verses.display_text: Wakefulness over wealth wastes the flesh, and anxiety about it drives away sleep.

verses.text: The anxiety of wakefulness will drive away drowsiness, and a severe illness will rouse a person from sleep.
verses.display_text: The anxiety of wakefulness will drive away drowsiness, and a severe illness will rouse a person from sleep.

verses.text: A rich person toiled in gathering money, and at rest he is filled with his luxuries.
verses.display_text: A rich person toiled in gathering money, and at rest he is filled with his luxuries.

verses.text: A poor person toiled with a diminished livelihood, and at rest he becomes needy.
verses.display_text: A poor person toiled with a diminished livelihood, and at rest he becomes needy.

verses.text: The one who loves gold will not be justified, and the one who pursues profits will go astray in them.
verses.display_text: The one who loves gold will not be justified, and the one who pursues profits will go astray in them.

verses.text: Many were given over to ruin for gold, and their destruction happened before their face.
verses.display_text: Many were given over to ruin for gold, and their destruction happened before their face.

verses.text: It is a stumbling block for those infatuated with it, and every fool will be caught by it.
verses.display_text: It is a stumbling block for those infatuated with it, and every fool will be caught by it.

verses.text: Happy is the rich person who was found blameless and did not go after gold.
verses.display_text: Happy is the rich person who was found blameless and did not go after gold.

verses.text: Who is he? We will call him happy, for he has done wonderful things among his people.
verses.display_text: Who is he? We will call him happy, for he has done wonderful things among his people.

verses.text: Who was tested by it and brought to completion? It will be a boast for him. Who could have transgressed and did not transgress, could have done evil things and did not do them?
verses.display_text: Who was tested by it and brought to completion? It will be a boast for him. Who could have transgressed and did not transgress, could have done evil things and did not do them?

verses.text: His good circumstances will be established, and the assembly will recount his almsgiving.
verses.display_text: His good circumstances will be established, and the assembly will recount his almsgiving.

verses.text: Have you sat at a great table? Do not open your throat over it or say, “How much there is upon it!”
verses.display_text: Have you sat at a great table? Do not open your throat over it or say, “How much there is upon it!”

verses.text: Remember that an evil eye is bad. What has been created worse than an eye? Therefore it weeps for every reason.
verses.display_text: Remember that an evil eye is bad. What has been created worse than an eye? Therefore it weeps for every reason.

verses.text: Do not stretch your hand toward whatever it looks at, and do not crowd together with it in the dish.
verses.display_text: Do not stretch your hand toward whatever it looks at, and do not crowd together with it in the dish.

verses.text: Understand your neighbor’s concerns from yourself, and consider every matter.
verses.display_text: Understand your neighbor’s concerns from yourself, and consider every matter.

verses.text: Eat what is set before you like a human being, and do not chew greedily, lest you be hated.
verses.display_text: Eat what is set before you like a human being, and do not chew greedily, lest you be hated.

verses.text: Be the first to stop for the sake of good discipline; do not be insatiable, lest you stumble.
verses.display_text: Be the first to stop for the sake of good discipline; do not be insatiable, lest you stumble.

verses.text: If you have sat among many, do not stretch out your hand before them.
verses.display_text: If you have sat among many, do not stretch out your hand before them.

verses.text: How sufficient a little is for an instructed person! He does not pant upon his bed.
verses.display_text: How sufficient a little is for an instructed person! He does not pant upon his bed.

verses.text: Healthy sleep comes with a moderate stomach. He rose early, and his soul was with him. The pain of sleeplessness, bilious vomiting, and cramp accompany an insatiable man.
verses.display_text: Healthy sleep comes with a moderate stomach. He rose early, and his soul was with him. The pain of sleeplessness, bilious vomiting, and cramp accompany an insatiable man.

verses.text: If you have been forced to eat too much, rise, vomit at a distance, and you will find rest.
verses.display_text: If you have been forced to eat too much, rise, vomit at a distance, and you will find rest.

verses.text: Listen to me, child, and do not despise me; in the end you will find my words true. In all your works be skillful, and no illness at all will meet you.
verses.display_text: Listen to me, child, and do not despise me; in the end you will find my words true. In all your works be skillful, and no illness at all will meet you.

verses.text: Lips will bless the generous provider of bread, and testimony to his excellence is trustworthy.
verses.display_text: Lips will bless the generous provider of bread, and testimony to his excellence is trustworthy.

verses.text: A city will grumble against someone stingy with bread, and testimony to his meanness is precise.
verses.display_text: A city will grumble against someone stingy with bread, and testimony to his meanness is precise.

verses.text: Do not show your manliness with wine, for wine has destroyed many.
verses.display_text: Do not show your manliness with wine, for wine has destroyed many.

verses.text: A furnace tests hardened metal in quenching; so wine tests hearts in the quarrel of the proud.
verses.display_text: A furnace tests hardened metal in quenching; so wine tests hearts in the quarrel of the proud.

verses.text: Wine is like life for human beings if you drink it in its measure. What is life for someone lacking wine? It too was created for human gladness.
verses.display_text: Wine is like life for human beings if you drink it in its measure. What is life for someone lacking wine? It too was created for human gladness.

verses.text: Wine drunk at the proper time in sufficient measure is rejoicing of heart and gladness of soul.
verses.display_text: Wine drunk at the proper time in sufficient measure is rejoicing of heart and gladness of soul.

verses.text: Wine drunk in quantity amid provocation and conflict is bitterness of soul.
verses.display_text: Wine drunk in quantity amid provocation and conflict is bitterness of soul.

verses.text: Drunkenness multiplies a fool’s anger to his stumbling, diminishing strength and adding wounds.
verses.display_text: Drunkenness multiplies a fool’s anger to his stumbling, diminishing strength and adding wounds.

verses.text: At a wine banquet do not rebuke your neighbor or despise him in his gladness. Do not speak a reproachful word to him or distress him with a demand for repayment.
verses.display_text: At a wine banquet do not rebuke your neighbor or despise him in his gladness. Do not speak a reproachful word to him or distress him with a demand for repayment.

verses.text: Have they appointed you leader? Do not exalt yourself. Be among them as one of them; take care of them, and then sit down.
verses.display_text: Have they appointed you leader? Do not exalt yourself. Be among them as one of them; take care of them, and then sit down.

verses.text: After attending to every duty, recline, so that you may rejoice because of them and receive a crown for good order.
verses.display_text: After attending to every duty, recline, so that you may rejoice because of them and receive a crown for good order.

verses.text: Speak, elder, for it is fitting for you, with exact knowledge, but do not hinder the music.
verses.display_text: Speak, elder, for it is fitting for you, with exact knowledge, but do not hinder the music.

verses.text: Where there is a performance, do not pour out chatter or display wisdom at an unsuitable time.
verses.display_text: Where there is a performance, do not pour out chatter or display wisdom at an unsuitable time.

verses.text: A carbuncle signet upon a golden ornament—so is an ensemble of musicians at a wine banquet.
verses.display_text: A carbuncle signet upon a golden ornament—so is an ensemble of musicians at a wine banquet.

verses.text: An emerald signet in a gold setting—so is musicians’ melody with pleasant wine.
verses.display_text: An emerald signet in a gold setting—so is musicians’ melody with pleasant wine.

verses.text: Speak, young man, if you are needed; scarcely twice, if you are asked.
verses.display_text: Speak, young man, if you are needed; scarcely twice, if you are asked.

verses.text: Sum up your speech, much in few words; be like someone who knows and at the same time keeps silent.
verses.display_text: Sum up your speech, much in few words; be like someone who knows and at the same time keeps silent.

verses.text: Among dignitaries do not make yourself their equal, and while another speaks do not chatter much.
verses.display_text: Among dignitaries do not make yourself their equal, and while another speaks do not chatter much.

verses.text: Lightning hastens before thunder, and grace will go ahead of a modest person.
verses.display_text: Lightning hastens before thunder, and grace will go ahead of a modest person.

verses.text: Rise at the right hour and do not linger at the rear; hurry home and do not be slack.
verses.display_text: Rise at the right hour and do not linger at the rear; hurry home and do not be slack.

verses.text: There enjoy yourself and carry out your thoughts, but do not sin by a proud word.
verses.display_text: There enjoy yourself and carry out your thoughts, but do not sin by a proud word.

verses.text: For these things bless your Maker, who intoxicates you with His good things.
verses.display_text: For these things bless your Maker, who intoxicates you with His good things.

verses.text: The one who fears the Lord will receive instruction, and those who rise early will find favor.
verses.display_text: The one who fears the Lord will receive instruction, and those who rise early will find favor.

verses.text: The one who seeks the law will be filled with it, but the hypocrite will stumble in it.
verses.display_text: The one who seeks the law will be filled with it, but the hypocrite will stumble in it.

verses.text: Those who fear the Lord will find judgment and kindle ordinances like light.
verses.display_text: Those who fear the Lord will find judgment and kindle ordinances like light.

verses.text: A sinful person will turn aside a rebuke and find an interpretation according to his own will.
verses.display_text: A sinful person will turn aside a rebuke and find an interpretation according to his own will.

verses.text: A man of counsel will certainly not disregard a thought; an alien and proud person will not shrink from fear.
verses.display_text: A man of counsel will certainly not disregard a thought; an alien and proud person will not shrink from fear.

verses.text: Do nothing without counsel, and after doing it, do not regret it.
verses.display_text: Do nothing without counsel, and after doing it, do not regret it.

verses.text: Do not walk on a road of obstacles, and do not stumble among stones.
verses.display_text: Do not walk on a road of obstacles, and do not stumble among stones.

verses.text: Do not trust a road free of stumbling blocks,
verses.display_text: Do not trust a road free of stumbling blocks,

verses.text: and guard yourself even against your children.
verses.display_text: and guard yourself even against your children.

verses.text: In every undertaking trust your soul, for this too is keeping commandments.
verses.display_text: In every undertaking trust your soul, for this too is keeping commandments.

verses.text: The one who trusts the law attends to commandments, and the one who trusts the Lord will not be diminished.
verses.display_text: The one who trusts the law attends to commandments, and the one who trusts the Lord will not be diminished.

verses.text: Evil will not meet the one who fears the Lord; even in testing he will be rescued again.
verses.display_text: Evil will not meet the one who fears the Lord; even in testing he will be rescued again.

verses.text: A wise man will not hate the law, but the one who acts hypocritically in it is like a ship in a storm.
verses.display_text: A wise man will not hate the law, but the one who acts hypocritically in it is like a ship in a storm.

verses.text: An understanding person will trust the law, and the law is trustworthy for him, like an answer from the sacred tokens.
verses.display_text: An understanding person will trust the law, and the law is trustworthy for him, like an answer from the sacred tokens.

verses.text: Prepare your speech, and so you will be heard; bind instruction together and answer.
verses.display_text: Prepare your speech, and so you will be heard; bind instruction together and answer.

verses.text: A fool’s inward parts are a cartwheel, and his deliberation is like a turning axle.
verses.display_text: A fool’s inward parts are a cartwheel, and his deliberation is like a turning axle.

verses.text: A breeding horse is like a mocking friend; he neighs beneath everyone who mounts him.
verses.display_text: A breeding horse is like a mocking friend; he neighs beneath everyone who mounts him.

verses.text: Why does one day surpass another when all the light of the year’s days comes from the sun?
verses.display_text: Why does one day surpass another when all the light of the year’s days comes from the sun?

verses.text: By the Lord’s knowledge they were distinguished, and He differentiated seasons and festivals.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s knowledge they were distinguished, and He differentiated seasons and festivals.

verses.text: Some He raised high and sanctified, and some He placed among the ordinary numbered days.
verses.display_text: Some He raised high and sanctified, and some He placed among the ordinary numbered days.

verses.text: All human beings are from the ground, and Adam was created from earth.
verses.display_text: All human beings are from the ground, and Adam was created from earth.

verses.text: In abundant knowledge the Lord distinguished them and differentiated their ways.
verses.display_text: In abundant knowledge the Lord distinguished them and differentiated their ways.

verses.text: Some He blessed and raised high, some He sanctified and brought near Himself; some He cursed and brought low, and overturned them from their position.
verses.display_text: Some He blessed and raised high, some He sanctified and brought near Himself; some He cursed and brought low, and overturned them from their position.

verses.text: Like a potter’s clay in his hand—all its ways are according to his pleasure—so are human beings in the hand of their Maker, for Him to repay them according to His judgment.
verses.display_text: Like a potter’s clay in his hand—all its ways are according to his pleasure—so are human beings in the hand of their Maker, for Him to repay them according to His judgment.

verses.text: Good stands opposite evil, and life opposite death; so a sinner stands opposite a godly person.
verses.display_text: Good stands opposite evil, and life opposite death; so a sinner stands opposite a godly person.

verses.text: Look in this way at all the Most High’s works: two by two, one opposite the other.
verses.display_text: Look in this way at all the Most High’s works: two by two, one opposite the other.

verses.text: I too, the last, kept watch like someone gleaning behind grape-gatherers.
verses.display_text: I too, the last, kept watch like someone gleaning behind grape-gatherers.

verses.text: By the Lord’s blessing I came in time, and like a grape-gatherer I filled a winepress.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s blessing I came in time, and like a grape-gatherer I filled a winepress.

verses.text: Consider that I have labored not for myself alone, but for all who seek instruction.
verses.display_text: Consider that I have labored not for myself alone, but for all who seek instruction.

verses.text: Listen to me, dignitaries of the people; give ear, leaders of the assembly.
verses.display_text: Listen to me, dignitaries of the people; give ear, leaders of the assembly.

verses.text: Do not give son or wife, brother or friend authority over you during your life. Do not give your money to another, lest afterward you regret it and beg for it.
verses.display_text: Do not give son or wife, brother or friend authority over you during your life. Do not give your money to another, lest afterward you regret it and beg for it.

verses.text: As long as you still live and breath is in you, do not exchange yourself for any flesh.
verses.display_text: As long as you still live and breath is in you, do not exchange yourself for any flesh.

verses.text: For it is better that your children ask you than that you look toward your sons’ hands.
verses.display_text: For it is better that your children ask you than that you look toward your sons’ hands.

verses.text: In all your works be preeminent; do not put a blemish upon your glory.
verses.display_text: In all your works be preeminent; do not put a blemish upon your glory.

verses.text: On the day when your life’s days are completed, at the time of death, distribute your inheritance.
verses.display_text: On the day when your life’s days are completed, at the time of death, distribute your inheritance.

verses.text: Fodder, a rod, and burdens for a donkey; bread, discipline, and work for a household slave.
verses.display_text: Fodder, a rod, and burdens for a donkey; bread, discipline, and work for a household slave.

verses.text: Make a servant work, and you will find rest; release his hands, and he will seek freedom.
verses.display_text: Make a servant work, and you will find rest; release his hands, and he will seek freedom.

verses.text: A yoke and strap will bend a neck, and racks and tortures are for a wrongdoing household slave.
verses.display_text: A yoke and strap will bend a neck, and racks and tortures are for a wrongdoing household slave.

verses.text: Put him to work so that he is not idle, for idleness has taught much evil.
verses.display_text: Put him to work so that he is not idle, for idleness has taught much evil.

verses.text: Assign him tasks as befits him, and if he does not obey, make his fetters heavy.
verses.display_text: Assign him tasks as befits him, and if he does not obey, make his fetters heavy.

verses.text: Do not go to excess against any flesh, and do nothing without judgment.
verses.display_text: Do not go to excess against any flesh, and do nothing without judgment.

verses.text: If you have a household slave, let him be as yourself, because you acquired him with blood.
verses.display_text: If you have a household slave, let him be as yourself, because you acquired him with blood.

verses.text: If you have a household slave, treat him as a brother, because you will need him as your own soul.
verses.display_text: If you have a household slave, treat him as a brother, because you will need him as your own soul.

verses.text: If you mistreat him and he leaves and runs away, on what road will you look for him?
verses.display_text: If you mistreat him and he leaves and runs away, on what road will you look for him?

verses.text: Empty and false hopes belong to a man without understanding, and dreams give wings to fools.
verses.display_text: Empty and false hopes belong to a man without understanding, and dreams give wings to fools.

verses.text: Like someone grasping a shadow and chasing wind is the one who relies on dreams.
verses.display_text: Like someone grasping a shadow and chasing wind is the one who relies on dreams.

verses.text: A dream vision is this set against that, a likeness of a face opposite a face.
verses.display_text: A dream vision is this set against that, a likeness of a face opposite a face.

verses.text: What will be cleansed from something unclean? What will prove true from something false?
verses.display_text: What will be cleansed from something unclean? What will prove true from something false?

verses.text: Divinations, omens, and dreams are vain, and the heart imagines like a woman in labor.
verses.display_text: Divinations, omens, and dreams are vain, and the heart imagines like a woman in labor.

verses.text: Unless they are sent from the Most High in a visitation, do not give your heart to them.
verses.display_text: Unless they are sent from the Most High in a visitation, do not give your heart to them.

verses.text: For dreams have led many astray, and those who hoped in them fell away.
verses.display_text: For dreams have led many astray, and those who hoped in them fell away.

verses.text: The law will be fulfilled without falsehood, and wisdom is fulfillment in a faithful mouth.
verses.display_text: The law will be fulfilled without falsehood, and wisdom is fulfillment in a faithful mouth.

verses.text: A man who has wandered has learned much, and one with much experience will recount understanding.
verses.display_text: A man who has wandered has learned much, and one with much experience will recount understanding.

verses.text: The one who has not been tested knows little, but the one who has wandered will increase in skill.
verses.display_text: The one who has not been tested knows little, but the one who has wandered will increase in skill.

verses.text: I have seen many things in my wandering, and my understanding exceeds my words.
verses.display_text: I have seen many things in my wandering, and my understanding exceeds my words.

verses.text: Often I was in danger to the point of death, and because of these things I was preserved.
verses.display_text: Often I was in danger to the point of death, and because of these things I was preserved.

verses.text: The spirit of those who fear the Lord will live, for their hope rests upon the One who saves them.
verses.display_text: The spirit of those who fear the Lord will live, for their hope rests upon the One who saves them.

verses.text: The one who fears the Lord will fear nothing and certainly not be cowardly, because He Himself is his hope.
verses.display_text: The one who fears the Lord will fear nothing and certainly not be cowardly, because He Himself is his hope.

verses.text: Happy is the soul of the one who fears the Lord! On whom does he rely? Who is his support?
verses.display_text: Happy is the soul of the one who fears the Lord! On whom does he rely? Who is his support?

verses.text: The Lord’s eyes are upon those who love Him: a mighty shield and strong support, shelter from scorching heat and shelter from midday, protection from stumbling and help against falling,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s eyes are upon those who love Him: a mighty shield and strong support, shelter from scorching heat and shelter from midday, protection from stumbling and help against falling,

verses.text: raising the soul and brightening the eyes, giving healing, life, and blessing.
verses.display_text: raising the soul and brightening the eyes, giving healing, life, and blessing.

verses.text: One who sacrifices from unjust gain makes a blemished offering, and the gifts of the lawless bring no acceptance.
verses.display_text: One who sacrifices from unjust gain makes a blemished offering, and the gifts of the lawless bring no acceptance.

verses.text: The Most High takes no pleasure in the offerings of the ungodly, nor does He atone for sins through a multitude of sacrifices.
verses.display_text: The Most High takes no pleasure in the offerings of the ungodly, nor does He atone for sins through a multitude of sacrifices.

verses.text: The one who presents a sacrifice from the property of the poor is slaughtering a son before his father.
verses.display_text: The one who presents a sacrifice from the property of the poor is slaughtering a son before his father.

verses.text: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; the one who deprives them of it is a man of blood.
verses.display_text: The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; the one who deprives them of it is a man of blood.

verses.text: The one who takes away a livelihood murders his neighbor, and the one who withholds a hired worker’s wage sheds blood.
verses.display_text: The one who takes away a livelihood murders his neighbor, and the one who withholds a hired worker’s wage sheds blood.

verses.text: One builds and another tears down; what have they gained beyond toil?
verses.display_text: One builds and another tears down; what have they gained beyond toil?

verses.text: One prays and another curses; whose voice will the Master hear?
verses.display_text: One prays and another curses; whose voice will the Master hear?

verses.text: Someone washes after contact with a corpse and then touches it again; what has he gained by his washing?
verses.display_text: Someone washes after contact with a corpse and then touches it again; what has he gained by his washing?

verses.text: So is a person who fasts over his sins and goes again to do the same things. Who will hear his prayer, and what has he gained by humbling himself?
verses.display_text: So is a person who fasts over his sins and goes again to do the same things. Who will hear his prayer, and what has he gained by humbling himself?

verses.text: The one who keeps the law multiplies offerings; the one who attends to commandments sacrifices a peace offering.
verses.display_text: The one who keeps the law multiplies offerings; the one who attends to commandments sacrifices a peace offering.

verses.text: The one who repays kindness offers fine flour, and the one who gives alms sacrifices a praise offering.
verses.display_text: The one who repays kindness offers fine flour, and the one who gives alms sacrifices a praise offering.

verses.text: To withdraw from wickedness is the Lord’s good pleasure, and to withdraw from injustice is atonement.
verses.display_text: To withdraw from wickedness is the Lord’s good pleasure, and to withdraw from injustice is atonement.

verses.text: Do not appear empty before the Lord, for all these things are for the commandment’s sake.
verses.display_text: Do not appear empty before the Lord, for all these things are for the commandment’s sake.

verses.text: A righteous person’s offering fattens the altar, and its fragrance is before the Most High.
verses.display_text: A righteous person’s offering fattens the altar, and its fragrance is before the Most High.

verses.text: A righteous man’s sacrifice is acceptable, and its memorial will not be forgotten.
verses.display_text: A righteous man’s sacrifice is acceptable, and its memorial will not be forgotten.

verses.text: Glorify the Lord with a generous eye, and do not diminish the firstfruits of your hands.
verses.display_text: Glorify the Lord with a generous eye, and do not diminish the firstfruits of your hands.

verses.text: With every gift make your face cheerful, and consecrate a tenth with gladness.
verses.display_text: With every gift make your face cheerful, and consecrate a tenth with gladness.

verses.text: Give to the Most High according to His gift, with a generous eye according to what your hand has found.
verses.display_text: Give to the Most High according to His gift, with a generous eye according to what your hand has found.

verses.text: For the Lord repays, and He will repay you sevenfold.
verses.display_text: For the Lord repays, and He will repay you sevenfold.

verses.text: Do not bribe, for He will not accept it, and do not rely on an unjust sacrifice.
verses.display_text: Do not bribe, for He will not accept it, and do not rely on an unjust sacrifice.

verses.text: For the Lord is judge, and with Him there is no prestige of persons.
verses.display_text: For the Lord is judge, and with Him there is no prestige of persons.

verses.text: He will not show partiality against the poor, and He will hear the petition of the wronged.
verses.display_text: He will not show partiality against the poor, and He will hear the petition of the wronged.

verses.text: He will certainly not disregard an orphan’s supplication or a widow when she pours out her words.
verses.display_text: He will certainly not disregard an orphan’s supplication or a widow when she pours out her words.

verses.text: Do not a widow’s tears run down her cheek, and her cry rise against the one who brought them down?
verses.display_text: Do not a widow’s tears run down her cheek, and her cry rise against the one who brought them down?

verses.text: The one who serves acceptably will be received, and his petition will reach as far as the clouds.
verses.display_text: The one who serves acceptably will be received, and his petition will reach as far as the clouds.

verses.text: A humble person’s prayer has passed through the clouds, and until it draws near, he will certainly not be comforted.
verses.display_text: A humble person’s prayer has passed through the clouds, and until it draws near, he will certainly not be comforted.

verses.text: He will certainly not withdraw until the Most High visits, judges in favor of the righteous, and executes judgment.
verses.display_text: He will certainly not withdraw until the Most High visits, judges in favor of the righteous, and executes judgment.

verses.text: The Lord will certainly not delay or be patient with them,
verses.display_text: The Lord will certainly not delay or be patient with them,

verses.text: until He crushes the loins of the merciless and repays the nations with retribution,
verses.display_text: until He crushes the loins of the merciless and repays the nations with retribution,

verses.text: until He removes the multitude of the insolent and crushes the scepters of the unjust,
verses.display_text: until He removes the multitude of the insolent and crushes the scepters of the unjust,

verses.text: until He repays a person according to his actions and judges human works according to their thoughts,
verses.display_text: until He repays a person according to his actions and judges human works according to their thoughts,

verses.text: until He judges His people’s case and gladdens them with His mercy.
verses.display_text: until He judges His people’s case and gladdens them with His mercy.

verses.text: Mercy is timely in the season of His people’s affliction, like rain clouds in a season without rain.
verses.display_text: Mercy is timely in the season of His people’s affliction, like rain clouds in a season without rain.

verses.text: Have mercy on us, Master, God of all; look upon us and cast Thy fear upon all the nations.
verses.display_text: Have mercy on us, Master, God of all; look upon us and cast Thy fear upon all the nations.

verses.text: Raise Thy hand against foreign nations, and let them see Thy dominion.
verses.display_text: Raise Thy hand against foreign nations, and let them see Thy dominion.

verses.text: Just as Thou wast sanctified in us before them, so mayest Thou be magnified in them before us.
verses.display_text: Just as Thou wast sanctified in us before them, so mayest Thou be magnified in them before us.

verses.text: Let them know Thee, as we also have known that there is no God except Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text: Let them know Thee, as we also have known that there is no God except Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Renew signs and make wonders different; glorify Thy hand and right arm.
verses.display_text: Renew signs and make wonders different; glorify Thy hand and right arm.

verses.text: Rouse anger and pour out wrath; remove the adversary and destroy the enemy.
verses.display_text: Rouse anger and pour out wrath; remove the adversary and destroy the enemy.

verses.text: Hasten the time and remember the oath, and let them recount Thy mighty deeds.
verses.display_text: Hasten the time and remember the oath, and let them recount Thy mighty deeds.

verses.text: Let the survivor be consumed in fiery wrath, and let those who harm Thy people find destruction.
verses.display_text: Let the survivor be consumed in fiery wrath, and let those who harm Thy people find destruction.

verses.text: Crush the heads of enemy rulers who say, “There is no one except us.”
verses.display_text: Crush the heads of enemy rulers who say, “There is no one except us.”

verses.text: Gather all the tribes of Jacob, and give them their inheritance as from the beginning.
verses.display_text: Gather all the tribes of Jacob, and give them their inheritance as from the beginning.

verses.text: Have mercy, Lord, on the people called by Thy name, and on Israel, whom Thou didst liken to a firstborn.
verses.display_text: Have mercy, Lord, on the people called by Thy name, and on Israel, whom Thou didst liken to a firstborn.

verses.text: Have compassion on the city of Thy sanctuary, Jerusalem, the place of Thy rest.
verses.display_text: Have compassion on the city of Thy sanctuary, Jerusalem, the place of Thy rest.

verses.text: Fill Zion with the recounting of Thine excellence, and Thy people with Thy glory.
verses.display_text: Fill Zion with the recounting of Thine excellence, and Thy people with Thy glory.

verses.text: Give testimony to those Thou didst create in the beginning, and raise up the prophecies spoken in Thy name.
verses.display_text: Give testimony to those Thou didst create in the beginning, and raise up the prophecies spoken in Thy name.

verses.text: Give a reward to those who wait for Thee, and let Thy prophets be found trustworthy.
verses.display_text: Give a reward to those who wait for Thee, and let Thy prophets be found trustworthy.

verses.text: Hear, Lord, the petition of Thy supplicants, according to Aaron’s blessing concerning Thy people,
verses.display_text: Hear, Lord, the petition of Thy supplicants, according to Aaron’s blessing concerning Thy people,

verses.text: and all those upon the earth will know that Thou art Lord, the God of the ages.
verses.display_text: and all those upon the earth will know that Thou art Lord, the God of the ages.

verses.text: The belly will eat every food, yet one food is better than another.
verses.display_text: The belly will eat every food, yet one food is better than another.

verses.text: The throat tastes food from the hunt; so an understanding heart tastes false words.
verses.display_text: The throat tastes food from the hunt; so an understanding heart tastes false words.

verses.text: A twisted heart will give grief, and a person of much experience will repay it.
verses.display_text: A twisted heart will give grief, and a person of much experience will repay it.

verses.text: A woman will accept any male, yet one daughter is better than another.
verses.display_text: A woman will accept any male, yet one daughter is better than another.

verses.text: A woman’s beauty gladdens the face and surpasses every human desire.
verses.display_text: A woman’s beauty gladdens the face and surpasses every human desire.

verses.text: If mercy and gentleness are upon her tongue, her husband is unlike ordinary human sons.
verses.display_text: If mercy and gentleness are upon her tongue, her husband is unlike ordinary human sons.

verses.text: The one who acquires a wife begins a possession: a helper corresponding to him and a pillar of rest.
verses.display_text: The one who acquires a wife begins a possession: a helper corresponding to him and a pillar of rest.

verses.text: Where there is no fence, property will be plundered; where there is no wife, a wanderer will groan.
verses.display_text: Where there is no fence, property will be plundered; where there is no wife, a wanderer will groan.

verses.text: For who will trust a well-girded robber springing from city to city?
verses.display_text: For who will trust a well-girded robber springing from city to city?

verses.text: So it is with a person who has no nest and lodges wherever evening overtakes him.
verses.display_text: So it is with a person who has no nest and lodges wherever evening overtakes him.

verses.text: Every friend will say, “I too have shown friendship,” but there is a friend who is a friend in name alone.
verses.display_text: Every friend will say, “I too have shown friendship,” but there is a friend who is a friend in name alone.

verses.text: Is there not grief to the point of death when a companion and friend turns to enmity?
verses.display_text: Is there not grief to the point of death when a companion and friend turns to enmity?

verses.text: O evil thought, from where did you roll in to cover the dry land with deceit?
verses.display_text: O evil thought, from where did you roll in to cover the dry land with deceit?

verses.text: A companion enjoys his friend’s gladness but will stand against him in a time of affliction.
verses.display_text: A companion enjoys his friend’s gladness but will stand against him in a time of affliction.

verses.text: A companion labors with a friend for his belly’s sake; before battle he will take up a shield.
verses.display_text: A companion labors with a friend for his belly’s sake; before battle he will take up a shield.

verses.text: Do not forget a friend in your soul or be unmindful of him in your wealth.
verses.display_text: Do not forget a friend in your soul or be unmindful of him in your wealth.

verses.text: Every counselor exalts counsel, but there is someone who counsels for himself.
verses.display_text: Every counselor exalts counsel, but there is someone who counsels for himself.

verses.text: Guard your soul against a counselor, and know beforehand what he needs—for he too will counsel for himself—lest he cast a lot against you
verses.display_text: Guard your soul against a counselor, and know beforehand what he needs—for he too will counsel for himself—lest he cast a lot against you

verses.text: and say to you, “Your road is good,” then stand opposite to see what happens to you.
verses.display_text: and say to you, “Your road is good,” then stand opposite to see what happens to you.

verses.text: Do not take counsel with someone who looks suspiciously at you, and hide your counsel from those who envy you.
verses.display_text: Do not take counsel with someone who looks suspiciously at you, and hide your counsel from those who envy you.

verses.text: Do not consult a woman about her rival, a coward about war, a merchant about exchange, a buyer about selling, a grudging person about gratitude, a merciless person about kindness, a lazy person about any work, a yearly hired worker about completing it, or an idle household slave about much labor. Do not rely on these for any counsel.
verses.display_text: Do not consult a woman about her rival, a coward about war, a merchant about exchange, a buyer about selling, a grudging person about gratitude, a merciless person about kindness, a lazy person about any work, a yearly hired worker about completing it, or an idle household slave about much labor. Do not rely on these for any counsel.

verses.text: Instead, remain with a godly man whom you know to keep commandments, whose soul is in accord with your soul, and who will share your pain if you stumble.
verses.display_text: Instead, remain with a godly man whom you know to keep commandments, whose soul is in accord with your soul, and who will share your pain if you stumble.

verses.text: Establish the counsel of your heart, for you have nothing more trustworthy than it.
verses.display_text: Establish the counsel of your heart, for you have nothing more trustworthy than it.

verses.text: For a man’s soul is sometimes accustomed to report more than seven watchmen seated high upon a watchtower.
verses.display_text: For a man’s soul is sometimes accustomed to report more than seven watchmen seated high upon a watchtower.

verses.text: Besides all these things, petition the Most High to make your road straight in truth.
verses.display_text: Besides all these things, petition the Most High to make your road straight in truth.

verses.text: A word is the beginning of every work, and counsel precedes every action.
verses.display_text: A word is the beginning of every work, and counsel precedes every action.

verses.text: The trace of a heart’s change brings forth four parts:
verses.display_text: The trace of a heart’s change brings forth four parts:

verses.text: good and evil, life and death; the tongue continually rules them.
verses.display_text: good and evil, life and death; the tongue continually rules them.

verses.text: There is a skillful man who instructs many, yet is useless to his own soul.
verses.display_text: There is a skillful man who instructs many, yet is useless to his own soul.

verses.text: There is someone who displays wisdom in words but is hated; this person will lack all food,
verses.display_text: There is someone who displays wisdom in words but is hated; this person will lack all food,

verses.text: for grace was not given him from the Lord, because he was deprived of all wisdom.
verses.display_text: for grace was not given him from the Lord, because he was deprived of all wisdom.

verses.text: There is someone wise for his own soul, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy upon his mouth.
verses.display_text: There is someone wise for his own soul, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy upon his mouth.

verses.text: A wise man will instruct his own people, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.
verses.display_text: A wise man will instruct his own people, and the fruits of his understanding are trustworthy.

verses.text: A wise man will be filled with blessing, and all who see him will call him happy.
verses.display_text: A wise man will be filled with blessing, and all who see him will call him happy.

verses.text: A man’s life is a number of days, but Israel’s days are beyond numbering.
verses.display_text: A man’s life is a number of days, but Israel’s days are beyond numbering.

verses.text: The wise person will inherit trust among his people, and his name will live for ever.
verses.display_text: The wise person will inherit trust among his people, and his name will live for ever.

verses.text: Child, in your life test your soul; see what is bad for it and do not give it that.
verses.display_text: Child, in your life test your soul; see what is bad for it and do not give it that.

verses.text: For not everything benefits everyone, and not every soul takes pleasure in everything.
verses.display_text: For not everything benefits everyone, and not every soul takes pleasure in everything.
