verses.text: Do not be insatiable in every luxury, and do not abandon yourself to dishes of food.
verses.display_text: Do not be insatiable in every luxury, and do not abandon yourself to dishes of food.

verses.text: For with much food there will be illness, and insatiability will approach the point of bilious vomiting.
verses.display_text: For with much food there will be illness, and insatiability will approach the point of bilious vomiting.

verses.text: Many have died through insatiability, but the one who takes care will add life.
verses.display_text: Many have died through insatiability, but the one who takes care will add life.

verses.text: Honor a physician with his due honors, according to the need for him; for the Lord created him also.
verses.display_text: Honor a physician with his due honors, according to the need for him; for the Lord created him also.

verses.text: For healing is from the Most High, and the physician will receive a gift from a king.
verses.display_text: For healing is from the Most High, and the physician will receive a gift from a king.

verses.text: A physician’s knowledge will raise his head, and he will be admired before dignitaries.
verses.display_text: A physician’s knowledge will raise his head, and he will be admired before dignitaries.

verses.text: The Lord created medicines from the earth, and a prudent man will not reject them.
verses.display_text: The Lord created medicines from the earth, and a prudent man will not reject them.

verses.text: Was not water sweetened by wood, so that its strength might be known?
verses.display_text: Was not water sweetened by wood, so that its strength might be known?

verses.text: He Himself gave human beings knowledge, to be glorified in His wonderful works.
verses.display_text: He Himself gave human beings knowledge, to be glorified in His wonderful works.

verses.text: By these He healed and removed the sufferer’s pain; with these a perfumer will make a mixture,
verses.display_text: By these He healed and removed the sufferer’s pain; with these a perfumer will make a mixture,

verses.text: and His works will certainly not come to an end; from Him there is peace upon the face of the earth.
verses.display_text: and His works will certainly not come to an end; from Him there is peace upon the face of the earth.

verses.text: Child, do not be negligent in your illness, but pray to the Lord, and He Himself will heal you.
verses.display_text: Child, do not be negligent in your illness, but pray to the Lord, and He Himself will heal you.

verses.text: Put wrongdoing away, straighten your hands, and cleanse your heart from every sin.
verses.display_text: Put wrongdoing away, straighten your hands, and cleanse your heart from every sin.

verses.text: Give a fragrant offering and a memorial of fine flour, and make your offering rich, as one who is no more.
verses.display_text: Give a fragrant offering and a memorial of fine flour, and make your offering rich, as one who is no more.

verses.text: Give the physician a place too, for the Lord created him; do not let him leave you, for you need him.
verses.display_text: Give the physician a place too, for the Lord created him; do not let him leave you, for you need him.

verses.text: There is a time when success is also in their hands,
verses.display_text: There is a time when success is also in their hands,

verses.text: for they themselves will petition the Lord to grant them success in relief and healing for the sake of preserving life.
verses.display_text: for they themselves will petition the Lord to grant them success in relief and healing for the sake of preserving life.

verses.text: May the one who sins before his Maker fall into a physician’s hands.
verses.display_text: May the one who sins before his Maker fall into a physician’s hands.

verses.text: Child, shed tears over the dead and begin a lament as one suffering terribly. Lay out his body according to his due, and do not neglect his burial.
verses.display_text: Child, shed tears over the dead and begin a lament as one suffering terribly. Lay out his body according to his due, and do not neglect his burial.

verses.text: Make your weeping bitter and your lament fervent; mourn according to his worth for one day or two because of slander, and be comforted because of grief.
verses.display_text: Make your weeping bitter and your lament fervent; mourn according to his worth for one day or two because of slander, and be comforted because of grief.

verses.text: For death comes from grief, and grief of heart will bend strength.
verses.display_text: For death comes from grief, and grief of heart will bend strength.

verses.text: In calamity grief also remains, and the poor person’s life weighs upon the heart.
verses.display_text: In calamity grief also remains, and the poor person’s life weighs upon the heart.

verses.text: Do not give your heart over to grief; put it away, remembering the last things.
verses.display_text: Do not give your heart over to grief; put it away, remembering the last things.

verses.text: Do not forget: there is no return. You will not benefit this person, and you will harm yourself.
verses.display_text: Do not forget: there is no return. You will not benefit this person, and you will harm yourself.

verses.text: “Remember my judgment, for yours is likewise: yesterday for me, today for you.”
verses.display_text: “Remember my judgment, for yours is likewise: yesterday for me, today for you.”

verses.text: When the dead person rests, bring his remembrance to rest, and be comforted concerning him when his spirit departs.
verses.display_text: When the dead person rests, bring his remembrance to rest, and be comforted concerning him when his spirit departs.

verses.text: A scribe’s wisdom comes through the opportunity of leisure; the one whose activity is reduced will become wise.
verses.display_text: A scribe’s wisdom comes through the opportunity of leisure; the one whose activity is reduced will become wise.

verses.text: How will someone become wise who holds a plow, boasts in a goad’s shaft, drives oxen, is occupied with their work, and whose talk is about the offspring of bulls?
verses.display_text: How will someone become wise who holds a plow, boasts in a goad’s shaft, drives oxen, is occupied with their work, and whose talk is about the offspring of bulls?

verses.text: He will give his heart to making furrows, and his wakefulness to fodder for heifers.
verses.display_text: He will give his heart to making furrows, and his wakefulness to fodder for heifers.

verses.text: So also every craftsman and master-builder who spends the night like the day, those who engrave signet engravings: his persistence is in varying the design. He will give his heart to making the depiction lifelike, and his wakefulness to finishing the work.
verses.display_text: So also every craftsman and master-builder who spends the night like the day, those who engrave signet engravings: his persistence is in varying the design. He will give his heart to making the depiction lifelike, and his wakefulness to finishing the work.

verses.text: So also a smith sitting near an anvil and studying works of iron: the fire’s vapor will melt his flesh, and he will struggle in the furnace’s heat. He will incline his ear to the hammer’s sound, and his eyes are upon the pattern of the vessel. He will give his heart to completing works, and his wakefulness to finishing their adornment.
verses.display_text: So also a smith sitting near an anvil and studying works of iron: the fire’s vapor will melt his flesh, and he will struggle in the furnace’s heat. He will incline his ear to the hammer’s sound, and his eyes are upon the pattern of the vessel. He will give his heart to completing works, and his wakefulness to finishing their adornment.

verses.text: So also a potter sitting at his work and turning a wheel with his feet, who is continually anxious over his work, and whose whole labor is measured by number.
verses.display_text: So also a potter sitting at his work and turning a wheel with his feet, who is continually anxious over his work, and whose whole labor is measured by number.

verses.text: With his arm he will shape clay, and before his feet he will bend his strength. He will give his heart to completing the coating, and his wakefulness to cleaning the kiln.
verses.display_text: With his arm he will shape clay, and before his feet he will bend his strength. He will give his heart to completing the coating, and his wakefulness to cleaning the kiln.

verses.text: All these trusted in their hands, and each shows skill in his own work.
verses.display_text: All these trusted in their hands, and each shows skill in his own work.

verses.text: Without them a city will not be settled, and people will neither sojourn nor walk about.
verses.display_text: Without them a city will not be settled, and people will neither sojourn nor walk about.

verses.text: Yet they will not be sought for the people’s council or rise high in the assembly; they will not sit on a judge’s chair or consider a covenant of judgment.
verses.display_text: Yet they will not be sought for the people’s council or rise high in the assembly; they will not sit on a judge’s chair or consider a covenant of judgment.

verses.text: They will certainly not make instruction and judgment known or be found among proverbs, but they will sustain the fabric of the world, and their petition is in the work of their craft.
verses.display_text: They will certainly not make instruction and judgment known or be found among proverbs, but they will sustain the fabric of the world, and their petition is in the work of their craft.

verses.text: Different is the one who gives his soul to considering the law of the Most High: he will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients and occupy himself with prophecies.
verses.display_text: Different is the one who gives his soul to considering the law of the Most High: he will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients and occupy himself with prophecies.

verses.text: He will preserve the discourse of renowned men and enter into the turns of parables.
verses.display_text: He will preserve the discourse of renowned men and enter into the turns of parables.

verses.text: He will seek out the hidden meanings of proverbs and dwell among the riddles of parables.
verses.display_text: He will seek out the hidden meanings of proverbs and dwell among the riddles of parables.

verses.text: He will serve among dignitaries and appear before rulers. He will pass through the land of foreign nations, for he has experienced good and evil among human beings.
verses.display_text: He will serve among dignitaries and appear before rulers. He will pass through the land of foreign nations, for he has experienced good and evil among human beings.

verses.text: He will give his heart to rising early before the Lord his Maker and petition the Most High. He will open his mouth in prayer and petition concerning his sins.
verses.display_text: He will give his heart to rising early before the Lord his Maker and petition the Most High. He will open his mouth in prayer and petition concerning his sins.

verses.text: If the great Lord is willing, he will be filled with a spirit of understanding. He himself will rain down words of his wisdom and give thanks to the Lord in prayer.
verses.display_text: If the great Lord is willing, he will be filled with a spirit of understanding. He himself will rain down words of his wisdom and give thanks to the Lord in prayer.

verses.text: He will direct his counsel and knowledge rightly and consider His hidden things.
verses.display_text: He will direct his counsel and knowledge rightly and consider His hidden things.

verses.text: He will reveal the instruction of his teaching and boast in the law of the Lord’s covenant.
verses.display_text: He will reveal the instruction of his teaching and boast in the law of the Lord’s covenant.

verses.text: Many will praise his understanding, and it will not be erased for ever. His memory will not depart, and his name will live for generations of generations.
verses.display_text: Many will praise his understanding, and it will not be erased for ever. His memory will not depart, and his name will live for generations of generations.

verses.text: Nations will recount his wisdom, and the assembly will proclaim his praise.
verses.display_text: Nations will recount his wisdom, and the assembly will proclaim his praise.

verses.text: If he remains, he will leave a name greater than a thousand; if he rests, it suffices for him.
verses.display_text: If he remains, he will leave a name greater than a thousand; if he rests, it suffices for him.

verses.text: Having reflected further, I will recount more, for I have become full like the moon at midmonth.
verses.display_text: Having reflected further, I will recount more, for I have become full like the moon at midmonth.

verses.text: Listen to me, holy sons, and sprout like a rose growing beside a flowing stream.
verses.display_text: Listen to me, holy sons, and sprout like a rose growing beside a flowing stream.

verses.text: Give a fragrant scent like frankincense, and blossom like a lily. Spread a scent and offer a song of praise; bless the Lord for all His works.
verses.display_text: Give a fragrant scent like frankincense, and blossom like a lily. Spread a scent and offer a song of praise; bless the Lord for all His works.

verses.text: Ascribe greatness to His name and give thanks with His praise, with songs of lips and lyres; and thus you will say in thanksgiving:
verses.display_text: Ascribe greatness to His name and give thanks with His praise, with songs of lips and lyres; and thus you will say in thanksgiving:

verses.text: “All the Lord’s works are very good, and every command will come to pass at its time. One cannot say, ‘What is this? What is this for?’ For everything will be sought at its time.
verses.display_text: “All the Lord’s works are very good, and every command will come to pass at its time. One cannot say, ‘What is this? What is this for?’ For everything will be sought at its time.

verses.text: At His word water stood like a heap, and at the utterance of His mouth came reservoirs of water.
verses.display_text: At His word water stood like a heap, and at the utterance of His mouth came reservoirs of water.

verses.text: In His command is all His good pleasure, and no one can diminish His salvation.
verses.display_text: In His command is all His good pleasure, and no one can diminish His salvation.

verses.text: The works of all flesh are before Him, and nothing can be hidden from His eyes.
verses.display_text: The works of all flesh are before Him, and nothing can be hidden from His eyes.

verses.text: From age to age He has looked upon everything, and nothing is astonishing before Him.
verses.display_text: From age to age He has looked upon everything, and nothing is astonishing before Him.

verses.text: One cannot say, ‘What is this? What is this for?’ For all things have been created for their uses.
verses.display_text: One cannot say, ‘What is this? What is this for?’ For all things have been created for their uses.

verses.text: His blessing covered like a river and drenched dry land like a flood.
verses.display_text: His blessing covered like a river and drenched dry land like a flood.

verses.text: So nations will inherit His wrath, as when He turned waters into brine.
verses.display_text: So nations will inherit His wrath, as when He turned waters into brine.

verses.text: His ways are straight for the holy, but likewise stumbling blocks for the lawless.
verses.display_text: His ways are straight for the holy, but likewise stumbling blocks for the lawless.

verses.text: Good things were created for the good from the beginning, and likewise evil things for sinners.
verses.display_text: Good things were created for the good from the beginning, and likewise evil things for sinners.

verses.text: The first necessities for human life are water, fire, iron, salt, fine wheat flour, milk, honey, the blood of the grape, oil, and clothing.
verses.display_text: The first necessities for human life are water, fire, iron, salt, fine wheat flour, milk, honey, the blood of the grape, oil, and clothing.

verses.text: All these are good for the godly, but likewise will turn into evils for sinners.
verses.display_text: All these are good for the godly, but likewise will turn into evils for sinners.

verses.text: There are spirits created for retribution; in His anger He made their scourges firm. At the time of completion they will pour out strength and assuage their Maker’s anger.
verses.display_text: There are spirits created for retribution; in His anger He made their scourges firm. At the time of completion they will pour out strength and assuage their Maker’s anger.

verses.text: Fire, hail, famine, and death—all these were created for retribution;
verses.display_text: Fire, hail, famine, and death—all these were created for retribution;

verses.text: the teeth of beasts, scorpions, vipers, and a sword exacting retribution upon the ungodly to their destruction.
verses.display_text: the teeth of beasts, scorpions, vipers, and a sword exacting retribution upon the ungodly to their destruction.

verses.text: They will rejoice in His command and be prepared upon the earth for their uses; at their times they will not transgress His word.”
verses.display_text: They will rejoice in His command and be prepared upon the earth for their uses; at their times they will not transgress His word.”

verses.text: Therefore from the beginning I stood firm, reflected, and left this in writing:
verses.display_text: Therefore from the beginning I stood firm, reflected, and left this in writing:

verses.text: “All the Lord’s works are good, and He will supply every need at its proper hour.
verses.display_text: “All the Lord’s works are good, and He will supply every need at its proper hour.

verses.text: One cannot say, ‘This is worse than that,’ for everything will prove good at its time.”
verses.display_text: One cannot say, ‘This is worse than that,’ for everything will prove good at its time.”

verses.text: And now sing hymns with all your heart and mouth, and bless the Lord’s name.
verses.display_text: And now sing hymns with all your heart and mouth, and bless the Lord’s name.

verses.text: Great occupation was created for every person, and a heavy yoke lies upon Adam’s sons, from the day they leave their mother’s womb until the day they return to the mother of all:
verses.display_text: Great occupation was created for every person, and a heavy yoke lies upon Adam’s sons, from the day they leave their mother’s womb until the day they return to the mother of all:

verses.text: their thoughts and fear of heart, anxious expectation, the day of death.
verses.display_text: their thoughts and fear of heart, anxious expectation, the day of death.

verses.text: From the one seated upon a glorious throne to the one brought low in earth and ashes,
verses.display_text: From the one seated upon a glorious throne to the one brought low in earth and ashes,

verses.text: from the one wearing blue and a crown to the one clothed in raw linen, there are anger, jealousy, trouble, upheaval, fear of death, resentment, and strife.
verses.display_text: from the one wearing blue and a crown to the one clothed in raw linen, there are anger, jealousy, trouble, upheaval, fear of death, resentment, and strife.

verses.text: Even at the time of rest upon a bed, night’s sleep alters his awareness.
verses.display_text: Even at the time of rest upon a bed, night’s sleep alters his awareness.

verses.text: He rests a little, almost nothing; then in sleep, as on a day of keeping watch, he is troubled by his heart’s vision, like someone who escaped from battle.
verses.display_text: He rests a little, almost nothing; then in sleep, as on a day of keeping watch, he is troubled by his heart’s vision, like someone who escaped from battle.

verses.text: At his time of need he woke, marveling that there was nothing to fear.
verses.display_text: At his time of need he woke, marveling that there was nothing to fear.

verses.text: This is with all flesh, from human being to beast, and for sinners sevenfold beyond these things:
verses.display_text: This is with all flesh, from human being to beast, and for sinners sevenfold beyond these things:

verses.text: death, blood, strife, sword, calamities, famine, crushing, and scourge.
verses.display_text: death, blood, strife, sword, calamities, famine, crushing, and scourge.

verses.text: All these things were created against the lawless, and because of them the flood occurred.
verses.display_text: All these things were created against the lawless, and because of them the flood occurred.

verses.text: Everything from earth returns to earth, and what comes from waters returns to the sea.
verses.display_text: Everything from earth returns to earth, and what comes from waters returns to the sea.

verses.text: Every bribe and injustice will be erased, but faithfulness will stand for ever.
verses.display_text: Every bribe and injustice will be erased, but faithfulness will stand for ever.

verses.text: The wealth of the unjust will dry up like a river and resound like great thunder in rain.
verses.display_text: The wealth of the unjust will dry up like a river and resound like great thunder in rain.

verses.text: When he opens his hands, he will rejoice; so transgressors will cease completely.
verses.display_text: When he opens his hands, he will rejoice; so transgressors will cease completely.

verses.text: The offspring of the ungodly will not multiply branches, and unclean roots rest upon sheer rock.
verses.display_text: The offspring of the ungodly will not multiply branches, and unclean roots rest upon sheer rock.

verses.text: Reed grass beside every water and riverbank will be plucked out before all other grass.
verses.display_text: Reed grass beside every water and riverbank will be plucked out before all other grass.

verses.text: Kindness is like a garden amid blessings, and almsgiving will remain for ever.
verses.display_text: Kindness is like a garden amid blessings, and almsgiving will remain for ever.

verses.text: The life of a self-sufficient person and a worker will be sweet, but above both is the one who finds treasure.
verses.display_text: The life of a self-sufficient person and a worker will be sweet, but above both is the one who finds treasure.

verses.text: Children and the building of a city establish a name, but a blameless wife is reckoned above both.
verses.display_text: Children and the building of a city establish a name, but a blameless wife is reckoned above both.

verses.text: Wine and music gladden the heart, but love of wisdom is above both.
verses.display_text: Wine and music gladden the heart, but love of wisdom is above both.

verses.text: Flute and harp sweeten melodies, but a pleasant tongue is above both.
verses.display_text: Flute and harp sweeten melodies, but a pleasant tongue is above both.

verses.text: An eye will desire grace and beauty, but above both the green growth of a crop.
verses.display_text: An eye will desire grace and beauty, but above both the green growth of a crop.

verses.text: Friend and companion meet at the right time, but above both is a wife with her husband.
verses.display_text: Friend and companion meet at the right time, but above both is a wife with her husband.

verses.text: Brothers and help are for a time of affliction, but almsgiving will rescue beyond both.
verses.display_text: Brothers and help are for a time of affliction, but almsgiving will rescue beyond both.

verses.text: Gold and silver will make the foot firm, but counsel proves better than both.
verses.display_text: Gold and silver will make the foot firm, but counsel proves better than both.

verses.text: Money and strength will lift the heart, but fear of the Lord is above both. There is no lack in the fear of the Lord, and in it there is no need to seek help.
verses.display_text: Money and strength will lift the heart, but fear of the Lord is above both. There is no lack in the fear of the Lord, and in it there is no need to seek help.

verses.text: The fear of the Lord is like a garden of blessing, and it has sheltered a person beyond all glory.
verses.display_text: The fear of the Lord is like a garden of blessing, and it has sheltered a person beyond all glory.

verses.text: Child, do not live a life of begging; it is better to die than to beg.
verses.display_text: Child, do not live a life of begging; it is better to die than to beg.

verses.text: A man who looks toward another’s table has no livelihood reckoned as life; he will defile his soul with others’ dishes. But a knowledgeable and instructed man will guard himself.
verses.display_text: A man who looks toward another’s table has no livelihood reckoned as life; he will defile his soul with others’ dishes. But a knowledgeable and instructed man will guard himself.

verses.text: Begging will be sweet in a shameless person’s mouth, but fire will burn in his belly.
verses.display_text: Begging will be sweet in a shameless person’s mouth, but fire will burn in his belly.

verses.text: O death, how bitter is your remembrance to a person at peace among his possessions, to a man free from distraction and prospering in everything, who still has strength to take food!
verses.display_text: O death, how bitter is your remembrance to a person at peace among his possessions, to a man free from distraction and prospering in everything, who still has strength to take food!

verses.text: O death, how good is your sentence to a person in need and declining in strength, extremely old and distracted about everything, resistant and having lost endurance!
verses.display_text: O death, how good is your sentence to a person in need and declining in strength, extremely old and distracted about everything, resistant and having lost endurance!

verses.text: Do not fear death’s sentence; remember those before you and those who come afterward.
verses.display_text: Do not fear death’s sentence; remember those before you and those who come afterward.

verses.text: This is the sentence from the Lord upon all flesh. Why do you refuse what pleases the Most High? Whether ten or a hundred or a thousand years, in Hades there is no reproach concerning one’s life.
verses.display_text: This is the sentence from the Lord upon all flesh. Why do you refuse what pleases the Most High? Whether ten or a hundred or a thousand years, in Hades there is no reproach concerning one’s life.

verses.text: The children of sinners become loathsome children, those who associate with the dwellings of the ungodly.
verses.display_text: The children of sinners become loathsome children, those who associate with the dwellings of the ungodly.

verses.text: The inheritance of sinners’ children will perish, and reproach will remain continually with their offspring.
verses.display_text: The inheritance of sinners’ children will perish, and reproach will remain continually with their offspring.

verses.text: Children will blame an ungodly father, because they will be reproached on his account.
verses.display_text: Children will blame an ungodly father, because they will be reproached on his account.

verses.text: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have abandoned the law of God Most High!
verses.display_text: Woe to you, ungodly men, who have abandoned the law of God Most High!

verses.text: If you are born, you will be born for a curse; if you die, you will be allotted to a curse.
verses.display_text: If you are born, you will be born for a curse; if you die, you will be allotted to a curse.

verses.text: Everything that comes from earth will depart into earth; so the ungodly go from a curse to destruction.
verses.display_text: Everything that comes from earth will depart into earth; so the ungodly go from a curse to destruction.

verses.text: People’s mourning concerns their bodies, but the name of sinners, being no good, will be blotted out.
verses.display_text: People’s mourning concerns their bodies, but the name of sinners, being no good, will be blotted out.

verses.text: Take care of your name, for it will remain with you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold.
verses.display_text: Take care of your name, for it will remain with you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold.

verses.text: A good life has a numbered span of days, but a good name will remain for ever.
verses.display_text: A good life has a numbered span of days, but a good name will remain for ever.

verses.text: Children, preserve instruction in peace. But hidden wisdom and an unseen treasure—what benefit is there in either?
verses.display_text: Children, preserve instruction in peace. But hidden wisdom and an unseen treasure—what benefit is there in either?

verses.text: A person who hides his foolishness is better than a person who hides his wisdom.
verses.display_text: A person who hides his foolishness is better than a person who hides his wisdom.

verses.text: Therefore, be ashamed in accordance with my word. For it is not good to preserve every kind of shame, and not everything finds approval with everyone in good faith.
verses.display_text: Therefore, be ashamed in accordance with my word. For it is not good to preserve every kind of shame, and not everything finds approval with everyone in good faith.

verses.text: Be ashamed before father and mother concerning sexual immorality, and before a leader and ruler concerning a lie;
verses.display_text: Be ashamed before father and mother concerning sexual immorality, and before a leader and ruler concerning a lie;

verses.text: before a judge and magistrate concerning an offense, and before an assembly and people concerning lawlessness;
verses.display_text: before a judge and magistrate concerning an offense, and before an assembly and people concerning lawlessness;

verses.text: before a partner and friend concerning injustice, and before the place where you reside concerning theft;
verses.display_text: before a partner and friend concerning injustice, and before the place where you reside concerning theft;

verses.text: before the truth of God and His covenant, and of planting your elbow upon bread;
verses.display_text: before the truth of God and His covenant, and of planting your elbow upon bread;

verses.text: of contempt in receiving and giving, and of silence toward those who greet you;
verses.display_text: of contempt in receiving and giving, and of silence toward those who greet you;

verses.text: of looking at a courtesan, and of turning your face away from a relative;
verses.display_text: of looking at a courtesan, and of turning your face away from a relative;

verses.text: of taking away a portion and a gift, and of scrutinizing a married woman;
verses.display_text: of taking away a portion and a gift, and of scrutinizing a married woman;

verses.text: of meddling with his maidservant—and do not stand over her bed;
verses.display_text: of meddling with his maidservant—and do not stand over her bed;

verses.text: before friends concerning words of reproach—and after giving, do not reproach;
verses.display_text: before friends concerning words of reproach—and after giving, do not reproach;

verses.text: of repeating a report you have heard, and of concealing secret words.
verses.display_text: of repeating a report you have heard, and of concealing secret words.

verses.text: Then you will be truly modest and find favor before every person.
verses.display_text: Then you will be truly modest and find favor before every person.

verses.text: Do not be ashamed of these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:
verses.display_text: Do not be ashamed of these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:

verses.text: of the law of the Most High and His covenant, and of a judgment that acquits the ungodly;
verses.display_text: of the law of the Most High and His covenant, and of a judgment that acquits the ungodly;

verses.text: of an accounting with a partner and fellow travelers, and of giving an inheritance to companions;
verses.display_text: of an accounting with a partner and fellow travelers, and of giving an inheritance to companions;

verses.text: of accuracy in scales and weights, and of acquiring much or little;
verses.display_text: of accuracy in scales and weights, and of acquiring much or little;

verses.text: of profit from merchants’ sales, of much discipline for children, and of making an evil household slave’s side bleed.
verses.display_text: of profit from merchants’ sales, of much discipline for children, and of making an evil household slave’s side bleed.

verses.text: With an evil woman, a seal is good; where there are many hands, lock things up.
verses.display_text: With an evil woman, a seal is good; where there are many hands, lock things up.

verses.text: Whatever you hand over, do so by number and weight; every giving and receiving should be in writing.
verses.display_text: Whatever you hand over, do so by number and weight; every giving and receiving should be in writing.

verses.text: Do not be ashamed of disciplining the senseless and foolish, or an extremely old man who contends with young people. Then you will be truly instructed and approved before everyone living.
verses.display_text: Do not be ashamed of disciplining the senseless and foolish, or an extremely old man who contends with young people. Then you will be truly instructed and approved before everyone living.

verses.text: A daughter is a secret cause of sleeplessness to her father, and anxiety about her drives sleep away: in her youth, lest she pass her prime; when married, lest she be hated;
verses.display_text: A daughter is a secret cause of sleeplessness to her father, and anxiety about her drives sleep away: in her youth, lest she pass her prime; when married, lest she be hated;

verses.text: in her virginity, lest she be defiled and become pregnant in her father’s home; while with a husband, lest she transgress; and when married, lest she be barren.
verses.display_text: in her virginity, lest she be defiled and become pregnant in her father’s home; while with a husband, lest she transgress; and when married, lest she be barren.

verses.text: Keep a firm watch over a headstrong daughter, lest she make you a delight to enemies, a subject of talk in the city, and an outcast of the people, and put you to shame among a great multitude.
verses.display_text: Keep a firm watch over a headstrong daughter, lest she make you a delight to enemies, a subject of talk in the city, and an outcast of the people, and put you to shame among a great multitude.

verses.text: Do not gaze at any person’s beauty, and do not sit among women.
verses.display_text: Do not gaze at any person’s beauty, and do not sit among women.

verses.text: For from clothes comes a moth, and from a woman comes a woman’s wickedness.
verses.display_text: For from clothes comes a moth, and from a woman comes a woman’s wickedness.

verses.text: A man’s wickedness is better than a woman who does good—and a woman who brings shame leads to reproach.
verses.display_text: A man’s wickedness is better than a woman who does good—and a woman who brings shame leads to reproach.

verses.text: I will now remember the Lord’s works and recount what I have seen. By the Lord’s words are His works.
verses.display_text: I will now remember the Lord’s works and recount what I have seen. By the Lord’s words are His works.

verses.text: The shining sun has looked upon everything, and His work is full of the Lord’s glory.
verses.display_text: The shining sun has looked upon everything, and His work is full of the Lord’s glory.

verses.text: He has not enabled the Lord’s holy ones to recount all His wonders, which the Lord Almighty established so that everything might stand firm in His glory.
verses.display_text: He has not enabled the Lord’s holy ones to recount all His wonders, which the Lord Almighty established so that everything might stand firm in His glory.

verses.text: He has traced out the abyss and the heart and considered their intricate workings. For the Most High knows all knowledge and has looked upon the sign of the age,
verses.display_text: He has traced out the abyss and the heart and considered their intricate workings. For the Most High knows all knowledge and has looked upon the sign of the age,

verses.text: announcing what has passed and what will be, and uncovering the traces of hidden things.
verses.display_text: announcing what has passed and what will be, and uncovering the traces of hidden things.

verses.text: No thought has escaped Him; not even one word has been hidden from Him.
verses.display_text: No thought has escaped Him; not even one word has been hidden from Him.

verses.text: He has set in order the great things of His wisdom, as He exists before the age and into the age. Nothing has been added or diminished, and He has had no need of any counselor.
verses.display_text: He has set in order the great things of His wisdom, as He exists before the age and into the age. Nothing has been added or diminished, and He has had no need of any counselor.

verses.text: How desirable all His works are! They are there to behold like a spark.
verses.display_text: How desirable all His works are! They are there to behold like a spark.

verses.text: All these live and remain for ever for every need, and all obey.
verses.display_text: All these live and remain for ever for every need, and all obey.

verses.text: All things are paired, one opposite another, and He has made nothing deficient.
verses.display_text: All things are paired, one opposite another, and He has made nothing deficient.

verses.text: One has confirmed the good things of another. Who will be filled with beholding His glory?
verses.display_text: One has confirmed the good things of another. Who will be filled with beholding His glory?

verses.text: The pride of the heights is the clear firmament, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.
verses.display_text: The pride of the heights is the clear firmament, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.

verses.text: The sun, appearing, announces as it rises: a wondrous instrument, a work of the Most High.
verses.display_text: The sun, appearing, announces as it rises: a wondrous instrument, a work of the Most High.

verses.text: At its noon it dries out the land; who will withstand its burning heat?
verses.display_text: At its noon it dries out the land; who will withstand its burning heat?

verses.text: One blows a furnace for works requiring heat, but the sun burns mountains three times as fiercely. Breathing out fiery vapors and flashing rays, it dims the eyes.
verses.display_text: One blows a furnace for works requiring heat, but the sun burns mountains three times as fiercely. Breathing out fiery vapors and flashing rays, it dims the eyes.

verses.text: Great is the Lord who made it, and by His words it hastened on its course.
verses.display_text: Great is the Lord who made it, and by His words it hastened on its course.

verses.text: The moon too is always there at its appointed time, a display of seasons and a sign of the age.
verses.display_text: The moon too is always there at its appointed time, a display of seasons and a sign of the age.

verses.text: From the moon comes the sign of a festival, a luminary that diminishes as it completes its course.
verses.display_text: From the moon comes the sign of a festival, a luminary that diminishes as it completes its course.

verses.text: The month takes its name from it. It grows wondrously in its changes, an instrument of the encampments on high, shining in the firmament of heaven.
verses.display_text: The month takes its name from it. It grows wondrously in its changes, an instrument of the encampments on high, shining in the firmament of heaven.

verses.text: The beauty of heaven is the glory of the stars, an ornament shining in the Lord’s heights.
verses.display_text: The beauty of heaven is the glory of the stars, an ornament shining in the Lord’s heights.

verses.text: At the Holy One’s words they will stand according to His judgment and will never grow slack in their watches.
verses.display_text: At the Holy One’s words they will stand according to His judgment and will never grow slack in their watches.

verses.text: Look at the rainbow and bless the One who made it, exceedingly beautiful in its radiance.
verses.display_text: Look at the rainbow and bless the One who made it, exceedingly beautiful in its radiance.

verses.text: It encircled heaven with a ring of glory; the hands of the Most High stretched it out.
verses.display_text: It encircled heaven with a ring of glory; the hands of the Most High stretched it out.

verses.text: By His command He hastened the snow and speeds the lightning of His judgment.
verses.display_text: By His command He hastened the snow and speeds the lightning of His judgment.

verses.text: Therefore the storehouses were opened, and clouds flew out like birds.
verses.display_text: Therefore the storehouses were opened, and clouds flew out like birds.

verses.text: By His greatness He strengthened the clouds, and hailstones were broken into pieces.
verses.display_text: By His greatness He strengthened the clouds, and hailstones were broken into pieces.

verses.text: At His appearing the mountains will be shaken; at His will the south wind will blow.
verses.display_text: At His appearing the mountains will be shaken; at His will the south wind will blow.

verses.text: The sound of His thunder rebuked the earth, as did the north wind’s storm and the whirling of wind.
verses.display_text: The sound of His thunder rebuked the earth, as did the north wind’s storm and the whirling of wind.

verses.text: Like birds flying down, He sprinkles snow; like a settling locust is its descent. The eye will marvel at the beauty of its whiteness, and the heart will be astounded by its falling shower.
verses.display_text: Like birds flying down, He sprinkles snow; like a settling locust is its descent. The eye will marvel at the beauty of its whiteness, and the heart will be astounded by its falling shower.

verses.text: He pours frost upon the earth like salt, and when frozen it becomes points of thorns.
verses.display_text: He pours frost upon the earth like salt, and when frozen it becomes points of thorns.

verses.text: A cold north wind will blow, and ice will freeze upon water. It will settle upon every gathering of water, and the water will put it on like a breastplate.
verses.display_text: A cold north wind will blow, and ice will freeze upon water. It will settle upon every gathering of water, and the water will put it on like a breastplate.

verses.text: It will consume mountains and burn the wilderness, and extinguish green growth like fire.
verses.display_text: It will consume mountains and burn the wilderness, and extinguish green growth like fire.

verses.text: A mist quickly brings healing to everything; dew arriving from the scorching heat will bring gladness.
verses.display_text: A mist quickly brings healing to everything; dew arriving from the scorching heat will bring gladness.

verses.text: By His purpose He stilled the abyss and planted islands in it.
verses.display_text: By His purpose He stilled the abyss and planted islands in it.

verses.text: Those who sail the sea recount its danger, and we marvel at what our ears hear.
verses.display_text: Those who sail the sea recount its danger, and we marvel at what our ears hear.

verses.text: There too are strange things and wondrous works, the variety of every living creature, the creation of sea monsters.
verses.display_text: There too are strange things and wondrous works, the variety of every living creature, the creation of sea monsters.

verses.text: Because of Him His messenger succeeds, and by His word all things hold together.
verses.display_text: Because of Him His messenger succeeds, and by His word all things hold together.

verses.text: We will say much and still never reach the end. The conclusion of our words is this: He is everything.
verses.display_text: We will say much and still never reach the end. The conclusion of our words is this: He is everything.

verses.text: When glorifying Him, where will we find strength? For He is greater than all His works.
verses.display_text: When glorifying Him, where will we find strength? For He is greater than all His works.

verses.text: The Lord is fearsome and exceedingly great, and His power is wondrous.
verses.display_text: The Lord is fearsome and exceedingly great, and His power is wondrous.

verses.text: As you glorify the Lord, exalt Him as much as you can, for He will surpass even that. As you exalt Him, increase your strength; do not grow weary, for you will never reach the end.
verses.display_text: As you glorify the Lord, exalt Him as much as you can, for He will surpass even that. As you exalt Him, increase your strength; do not grow weary, for you will never reach the end.

verses.text: Who has seen Him and will recount Him? Who will magnify Him as He is?
verses.display_text: Who has seen Him and will recount Him? Who will magnify Him as He is?

verses.text: Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen few of His works.
verses.display_text: Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen few of His works.

verses.text: For the Lord made all things, and He gave wisdom to the godly.
verses.display_text: For the Lord made all things, and He gave wisdom to the godly.

verses.text: Let us now praise glorious men, our fathers according to their generations.
verses.display_text: Let us now praise glorious men, our fathers according to their generations.

verses.text: The Lord created great glory, His majesty from of old.
verses.display_text: The Lord created great glory, His majesty from of old.

verses.text: There were those who ruled in their kingdoms, men renowned for power; those who counseled with their understanding, who made declarations in prophecies;
verses.display_text: There were those who ruled in their kingdoms, men renowned for power; those who counseled with their understanding, who made declarations in prophecies;

verses.text: leaders of the people in deliberations and in understanding the people’s writings, wise words being part of their instruction;
verses.display_text: leaders of the people in deliberations and in understanding the people’s writings, wise words being part of their instruction;

verses.text: those who sought out musical melodies and related verses in writing;
verses.display_text: those who sought out musical melodies and related verses in writing;

verses.text: wealthy men furnished with strength, living peacefully in their dwellings.
verses.display_text: wealthy men furnished with strength, living peacefully in their dwellings.

verses.text: All these were honored in their generations and were a source of boasting in their days.
verses.display_text: All these were honored in their generations and were a source of boasting in their days.

verses.text: Some of them left a name, so that their praises might be recounted.
verses.display_text: Some of them left a name, so that their praises might be recounted.

verses.text: But there are some of whom there is no remembrance, who perished as though they had never existed, becoming as though they had never been born, and their children after them.
verses.display_text: But there are some of whom there is no remembrance, who perished as though they had never existed, becoming as though they had never been born, and their children after them.

verses.text: Yet these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.
verses.display_text: Yet these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.

verses.text: It will remain with their offspring; their descendants are a good inheritance.
verses.display_text: It will remain with their offspring; their descendants are a good inheritance.

verses.text: Their offspring stood within the covenants, and their children did so because of them.
verses.display_text: Their offspring stood within the covenants, and their children did so because of them.

verses.text: Their offspring will remain for ever, and their glory will not be blotted out.
verses.display_text: Their offspring will remain for ever, and their glory will not be blotted out.

verses.text: Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives through generations.
verses.display_text: Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives through generations.

verses.text: Peoples will recount their wisdom, and the assembly proclaims their praise.
verses.display_text: Peoples will recount their wisdom, and the assembly proclaims their praise.

verses.text: Enoch pleased the Lord and was taken away, an example of repentance to the generations.
verses.display_text: Enoch pleased the Lord and was taken away, an example of repentance to the generations.

verses.text: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in a time of wrath he became an exchange. Through him a remnant was left to the earth when the flood came.
verses.display_text: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in a time of wrath he became an exchange. Through him a remnant was left to the earth when the flood came.

verses.text: Everlasting covenants were established with him, so that all flesh might not be wiped out by a flood.
verses.display_text: Everlasting covenants were established with him, so that all flesh might not be wiped out by a flood.

verses.text: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations, and no one like him was found in glory.
verses.display_text: Abraham was a great father of a multitude of nations, and no one like him was found in glory.

verses.text: He kept the law of the Most High and entered a covenant with Him. He established a covenant in his flesh, and under testing he was found faithful.
verses.display_text: He kept the law of the Most High and entered a covenant with Him. He established a covenant in his flesh, and under testing he was found faithful.

verses.text: Therefore He assured him by an oath that nations would be blessed in his offspring, that He would multiply him like the dust of the earth, raise his offspring like the stars, and give them an inheritance from sea to sea and from the River to the end of the earth.
verses.display_text: Therefore He assured him by an oath that nations would be blessed in his offspring, that He would multiply him like the dust of the earth, raise his offspring like the stars, and give them an inheritance from sea to sea and from the River to the end of the earth.

verses.text: In Isaac He established it in the same way, because of Abraham his father.
verses.display_text: In Isaac He established it in the same way, because of Abraham his father.

verses.text: He caused the blessing of all people and the covenant to rest upon Jacob’s head. He acknowledged him with His blessings and gave him an inheritance. He distinguished his portions and divided them among twelve tribes.
verses.display_text: He caused the blessing of all people and the covenant to rest upon Jacob’s head. He acknowledged him with His blessings and gave him an inheritance. He distinguished his portions and divided them among twelve tribes.

verses.text: From him He brought forth a man of mercy who found favor in the eyes of all flesh, beloved by God and people: Moses, whose remembrance is among blessings.
verses.display_text: From him He brought forth a man of mercy who found favor in the eyes of all flesh, beloved by God and people: Moses, whose remembrance is among blessings.

verses.text: He made him like the holy ones in glory and magnified him through the fears of his enemies.
verses.display_text: He made him like the holy ones in glory and magnified him through the fears of his enemies.

verses.text: By his words He caused signs to cease; He glorified him before kings. He gave him commandments for His people and showed him something of His glory.
verses.display_text: By his words He caused signs to cease; He glorified him before kings. He gave him commandments for His people and showed him something of His glory.

verses.text: In faithfulness and gentleness He sanctified him; He chose him out of all flesh.
verses.display_text: In faithfulness and gentleness He sanctified him; He chose him out of all flesh.

verses.text: He let him hear His voice, brought him into the darkness, and gave him commandments face to face, a law of life and knowledge, to teach Jacob the covenant and Israel His judgments.
verses.display_text: He let him hear His voice, brought him into the darkness, and gave him commandments face to face, a law of life and knowledge, to teach Jacob the covenant and Israel His judgments.

verses.text: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like him, his brother from the tribe of Levi.
verses.display_text: He exalted Aaron, a holy man like him, his brother from the tribe of Levi.

verses.text: He established him as an everlasting covenant and gave him the priesthood of the people. He blessed him with beautiful attire and girded him with a robe of glory.
verses.display_text: He established him as an everlasting covenant and gave him the priesthood of the people. He blessed him with beautiful attire and girded him with a robe of glory.

verses.text: He clothed him with the fullness of splendor and equipped him with mighty garments: breeches, a robe reaching to the feet, and a shoulder piece.
verses.display_text: He clothed him with the fullness of splendor and equipped him with mighty garments: breeches, a robe reaching to the feet, and a shoulder piece.

verses.text: He surrounded him with little pomegranates, with many golden bells all around, to sound with his footsteps and make an audible ringing in the sanctuary as a remembrance for the sons of His people;
verses.display_text: He surrounded him with little pomegranates, with many golden bells all around, to sound with his footsteps and make an audible ringing in the sanctuary as a remembrance for the sons of His people;

verses.text: with a holy robe of gold, blue, and purple, the work of an embroiderer; with an oracle-piece of judgment, tokens of truth, twisted scarlet, a craftsman’s work;
verses.display_text: with a holy robe of gold, blue, and purple, the work of an embroiderer; with an oracle-piece of judgment, tokens of truth, twisted scarlet, a craftsman’s work;

verses.text: with costly stones bearing engraved seals in settings of gold, a stoneworker’s work, as a remembrance in carved writing according to the number of Israel’s tribes;
verses.display_text: with costly stones bearing engraved seals in settings of gold, a stoneworker’s work, as a remembrance in carved writing according to the number of Israel’s tribes;

verses.text: with a golden crown upon the turban, the impression of a seal of holiness, an honor to boast of, a mighty work, beautifully adorned things desired by the eyes.
verses.display_text: with a golden crown upon the turban, the impression of a seal of holiness, an honor to boast of, a mighty work, beautifully adorned things desired by the eyes.

verses.text: Before him there had never been such beautiful things. No outsider has ever worn them, but only his sons and his descendants continually.
verses.display_text: Before him there had never been such beautiful things. No outsider has ever worn them, but only his sons and his descendants continually.

verses.text: His sacrifices will be wholly offered twice every day, continually.
verses.display_text: His sacrifices will be wholly offered twice every day, continually.

verses.text: Moses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil. It became an everlasting covenant for him and his offspring, throughout the days of heaven, to minister to Him, serve as priests, and bless His people in the Name.
verses.display_text: Moses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil. It became an everlasting covenant for him and his offspring, throughout the days of heaven, to minister to Him, serve as priests, and bless His people in the Name.

verses.text: He chose him from every living person to present an offering to the Lord, incense and a pleasing fragrance as a remembrance, to make atonement for your people.
verses.display_text: He chose him from every living person to present an offering to the Lord, incense and a pleasing fragrance as a remembrance, to make atonement for your people.

verses.text: In His commandments He gave him authority concerning covenants of judgments, to teach Jacob the testimonies and enlighten Israel through His law.
verses.display_text: In His commandments He gave him authority concerning covenants of judgments, to teach Jacob the testimonies and enlighten Israel through His law.

verses.text: Outsiders banded together against him and envied him in the wilderness: the men around Dathan and Abiram, and Korah’s assembly in anger and wrath.
verses.display_text: Outsiders banded together against him and envied him in the wilderness: the men around Dathan and Abiram, and Korah’s assembly in anger and wrath.

verses.text: The Lord saw and was not pleased, and they were brought to their end in furious wrath. He worked portents upon them, consuming them in His flaming fire.
verses.display_text: The Lord saw and was not pleased, and they were brought to their end in furious wrath. He worked portents upon them, consuming them in His flaming fire.

verses.text: He added glory to Aaron and gave him an inheritance. He allotted him the firstfruits of the first produce; He prepared bread in abundance first for them.
verses.display_text: He added glory to Aaron and gave him an inheritance. He allotted him the firstfruits of the first produce; He prepared bread in abundance first for them.

verses.text: For they will eat the Lord’s sacrifices, which He gave both to him and to his offspring.
verses.display_text: For they will eat the Lord’s sacrifices, which He gave both to him and to his offspring.

verses.text: But he will inherit nothing in the people’s land, and he has no portion among the people, for He Himself is your portion and inheritance.
verses.display_text: But he will inherit nothing in the people’s land, and he has no portion among the people, for He Himself is your portion and inheritance.

verses.text: Phinehas son of Eleazar was third in glory, because he was zealous in the fear of the Lord and stood firm when the people turned away, with the goodness of his soul’s eagerness. He made atonement for Israel.
verses.display_text: Phinehas son of Eleazar was third in glory, because he was zealous in the fear of the Lord and stood firm when the people turned away, with the goodness of his soul’s eagerness. He made atonement for Israel.

verses.text: Therefore a covenant of peace was established for him, to preside over holy things and His people, so that the majesty of the priesthood might belong to him and his offspring for ever.
verses.display_text: Therefore a covenant of peace was established for him, to preside over holy things and His people, so that the majesty of the priesthood might belong to him and his offspring for ever.

verses.text: There was also a covenant for David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah: the inheritance of a king passes from son to son alone; Aaron’s inheritance belongs also to his offspring.
verses.display_text: There was also a covenant for David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah: the inheritance of a king passes from son to son alone; Aaron’s inheritance belongs also to his offspring.

verses.text: May He give you wisdom in your heart to judge His people in righteousness, so that their good things may not disappear, and their glory may last through their generations.
verses.display_text: May He give you wisdom in your heart to judge His people in righteousness, so that their good things may not disappear, and their glory may last through their generations.

verses.text: Mighty in war was Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ successor in prophecies. In keeping with his name he became great in the salvation of His chosen ones, taking vengeance on enemies who rose against them, so that he might give Israel its inheritance.
verses.display_text: Mighty in war was Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ successor in prophecies. In keeping with his name he became great in the salvation of His chosen ones, taking vengeance on enemies who rose against them, so that he might give Israel its inheritance.

verses.text: How glorious he was when he raised his hands and stretched out his sword against cities!
verses.display_text: How glorious he was when he raised his hands and stretched out his sword against cities!

verses.text: Who before him stood so firm? For he himself brought on the Lord’s wars.
verses.display_text: Who before him stood so firm? For he himself brought on the Lord’s wars.

verses.text: Was not the sun held back by his hand, and did not one day become as two?
verses.display_text: Was not the sun held back by his hand, and did not one day become as two?

verses.text: He called upon the Most High Ruler when enemies pressed him on every side, and the great Lord answered him with hailstones of mighty power.
verses.display_text: He called upon the Most High Ruler when enemies pressed him on every side, and the great Lord answered him with hailstones of mighty power.

verses.text: He hurled war down upon a nation and destroyed those who resisted on the descent, so that the nations might know his full armament, because his war was before the Lord.
verses.display_text: He hurled war down upon a nation and destroyed those who resisted on the descent, so that the nations might know his full armament, because his war was before the Lord.

verses.text: For he followed the Ruler, and in Moses’ days he showed mercy, he and Caleb son of Jephunneh, by standing against the assembly, restraining the people from sin, and stilling wicked grumbling.
verses.display_text: For he followed the Ruler, and in Moses’ days he showed mercy, he and Caleb son of Jephunneh, by standing against the assembly, restraining the people from sin, and stilling wicked grumbling.

verses.text: They alone, being two, were preserved from six hundred thousand foot soldiers, to bring them into an inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.display_text: They alone, being two, were preserved from six hundred thousand foot soldiers, to bring them into an inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.text: The Lord gave Caleb strength, and it remained with him until old age, so that he might mount the high places of the land; his offspring possessed an inheritance,
verses.display_text: The Lord gave Caleb strength, and it remained with him until old age, so that he might mount the high places of the land; his offspring possessed an inheritance,

verses.text: so that all the sons of Israel might see that it is good to walk after the Lord.
verses.display_text: so that all the sons of Israel might see that it is good to walk after the Lord.

verses.text: The judges too, each by his own name, whose hearts did not prostitute themselves and who did not turn away from the Lord—may their remembrance be among blessings!
verses.display_text: The judges too, each by his own name, whose hearts did not prostitute themselves and who did not turn away from the Lord—may their remembrance be among blessings!

verses.text: May their bones flourish again from their place, and may their name pass onward to their honored sons.
verses.display_text: May their bones flourish again from their place, and may their name pass onward to their honored sons.

verses.text: Beloved by his Lord, Samuel, the Lord’s prophet, established a kingdom and anointed rulers over His people.
verses.display_text: Beloved by his Lord, Samuel, the Lord’s prophet, established a kingdom and anointed rulers over His people.

verses.text: By the Lord’s law he judged the assembly, and the Lord visited Jacob.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s law he judged the assembly, and the Lord visited Jacob.

verses.text: By his faithfulness he was proved a prophet, and through his words he was known to be trustworthy in vision.
verses.display_text: By his faithfulness he was proved a prophet, and through his words he was known to be trustworthy in vision.

verses.text: He called upon the Lord, the Ruler, when his enemies pressed him on every side, with an offering of a suckling lamb.
verses.display_text: He called upon the Lord, the Ruler, when his enemies pressed him on every side, with an offering of a suckling lamb.

verses.text: The Lord thundered from heaven and made His voice heard with a great sound.
verses.display_text: The Lord thundered from heaven and made His voice heard with a great sound.

verses.text: He destroyed the leaders of the Tyrians and all the rulers of the Philistines.
verses.display_text: He destroyed the leaders of the Tyrians and all the rulers of the Philistines.

verses.text: Before the time of his everlasting sleep, he testified before the Lord and His anointed: “I have taken no property—not even sandals—from any human being.” And no person brought an accusation against him.
verses.display_text: Before the time of his everlasting sleep, he testified before the Lord and His anointed: “I have taken no property—not even sandals—from any human being.” And no person brought an accusation against him.

verses.text: Even after he fell asleep, he prophesied and showed the king his end. He raised his voice from the earth in prophecy to wipe out the people’s lawlessness.
verses.display_text: Even after he fell asleep, he prophesied and showed the king his end. He raised his voice from the earth in prophecy to wipe out the people’s lawlessness.

verses.text: After him Nathan arose to prophesy in David’s days.
verses.display_text: After him Nathan arose to prophesy in David’s days.

verses.text: As fat is set apart from a peace offering, so David was set apart from the sons of Israel.
verses.display_text: As fat is set apart from a peace offering, so David was set apart from the sons of Israel.

verses.text: He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.
verses.display_text: He played with lions as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of the flock.

verses.text: In his youth did he not kill a giant and remove reproach from the people, when he raised his hand with a sling stone and brought down Goliath’s pride?
verses.display_text: In his youth did he not kill a giant and remove reproach from the people, when he raised his hand with a sling stone and brought down Goliath’s pride?

verses.text: For he called upon the Lord Most High, and He put strength in his right hand to remove a mighty warrior and raise the horn of His people.
verses.display_text: For he called upon the Lord Most High, and He put strength in his right hand to remove a mighty warrior and raise the horn of His people.

verses.text: Thus they glorified him with tens of thousands and praised him with blessings of the Lord when a crown of glory was brought to him.
verses.display_text: Thus they glorified him with tens of thousands and praised him with blessings of the Lord when a crown of glory was brought to him.

verses.text: For he destroyed enemies all around and reduced his Philistine adversaries to nothing; he shattered their horn to this day.
verses.display_text: For he destroyed enemies all around and reduced his Philistine adversaries to nothing; he shattered their horn to this day.

verses.text: In every deed he gave thanks to the Holy Most High with a word of glory. With his whole heart he sang hymns and loved the One who made him.
verses.display_text: In every deed he gave thanks to the Holy Most High with a word of glory. With his whole heart he sang hymns and loved the One who made him.

verses.text: He stationed psalm singers before the altar, to sweeten the melodies with their sound.
verses.display_text: He stationed psalm singers before the altar, to sweeten the melodies with their sound.

verses.text: He gave festivals splendor and adorned the appointed seasons to their completion, while they praised His holy name and made the sanctuary resound from early morning.
verses.display_text: He gave festivals splendor and adorned the appointed seasons to their completion, while they praised His holy name and made the sanctuary resound from early morning.

verses.text: The Lord took away his sins, raised his horn for ever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.
verses.display_text: The Lord took away his sins, raised his horn for ever, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.

verses.text: After him arose a knowledgeable son, who because of him rested in spacious prosperity.
verses.display_text: After him arose a knowledgeable son, who because of him rested in spacious prosperity.

verses.text: Solomon reigned in days of peace; God gave him rest all around, so that he might establish a house for His name and prepare a sanctuary for ever.
verses.display_text: Solomon reigned in days of peace; God gave him rest all around, so that he might establish a house for His name and prepare a sanctuary for ever.

verses.text: How wise you became in your youth! You were filled with understanding like a river.
verses.display_text: How wise you became in your youth! You were filled with understanding like a river.

verses.text: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with comparisons containing riddles.
verses.display_text: Your soul covered the earth, and you filled it with comparisons containing riddles.

verses.text: Your name reached distant islands, and you were loved for your peace.
verses.display_text: Your name reached distant islands, and you were loved for your peace.

verses.text: Countries marveled at you for songs, proverbs, comparisons, and interpretations.
verses.display_text: Countries marveled at you for songs, proverbs, comparisons, and interpretations.

verses.text: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and multiplied silver like lead.
verses.display_text: In the name of the Lord God, who is called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and multiplied silver like lead.

verses.text: You bent your loins toward women and were brought under power in your body.
verses.display_text: You bent your loins toward women and were brought under power in your body.

verses.text: You put a blemish upon your glory and profaned your offspring, bringing wrath upon your children and anguish because of your folly,
verses.display_text: You put a blemish upon your glory and profaned your offspring, bringing wrath upon your children and anguish because of your folly,

verses.text: so that the dominion became divided and a disobedient kingdom began from Ephraim.
verses.display_text: so that the dominion became divided and a disobedient kingdom began from Ephraim.

verses.text: But the Lord will never abandon His mercy or let any of His words fail. He will never wipe out His chosen one’s descendants or remove the offspring of the one who loved Him. He gave Jacob a remnant, and David a root from him.
verses.display_text: But the Lord will never abandon His mercy or let any of His words fail. He will never wipe out His chosen one’s descendants or remove the offspring of the one who loved Him. He gave Jacob a remnant, and David a root from him.

verses.text: Solomon rested with his fathers and left after him, from his offspring, the people’s foolishness: Rehoboam, deficient in understanding, who made the people revolt through his counsel.
verses.display_text: Solomon rested with his fathers and left after him, from his offspring, the people’s foolishness: Rehoboam, deficient in understanding, who made the people revolt through his counsel.

verses.text: There was also Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin and gave Ephraim a path of sin. Their sins multiplied exceedingly, so that they were removed from their land.
verses.display_text: There was also Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin and gave Ephraim a path of sin. Their sins multiplied exceedingly, so that they were removed from their land.

verses.text: They sought out every kind of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.
verses.display_text: They sought out every kind of wickedness, until vengeance came upon them.

verses.text: Then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.
verses.display_text: Then Elijah arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch.

verses.text: He brought famine upon them and made them few through his zeal.
verses.display_text: He brought famine upon them and made them few through his zeal.

verses.text: By the Lord’s word he held back heaven; in the same way he brought down fire three times.
verses.display_text: By the Lord’s word he held back heaven; in the same way he brought down fire three times.

verses.text: How glorious you became, Elijah, through your wonders! Who can boast of being like you?
verses.display_text: How glorious you became, Elijah, through your wonders! Who can boast of being like you?

verses.text: You raised a dead man from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High.
verses.display_text: You raised a dead man from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High.

verses.text: You brought kings down to destruction and glorious men from their bed.
verses.display_text: You brought kings down to destruction and glorious men from their bed.

verses.text: You heard rebuke at Sinai and judgments of vengeance at Horeb.
verses.display_text: You heard rebuke at Sinai and judgments of vengeance at Horeb.

verses.text: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him.
verses.display_text: You anointed kings for retribution, and prophets as successors after him.

verses.text: You were taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot with fiery horses.
verses.display_text: You were taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot with fiery horses.

verses.text: You were recorded in rebukes for appointed times: to still anger before wrath, to turn a father’s heart toward a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.display_text: You were recorded in rebukes for appointed times: to still anger before wrath, to turn a father’s heart toward a son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

verses.text: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have fallen asleep in love; for we too will surely live.
verses.display_text: Blessed are those who saw you and those who have fallen asleep in love; for we too will surely live.

verses.text: Elijah was covered by a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one overpowered him.
verses.display_text: Elijah was covered by a whirlwind, and Elisha was filled with his spirit. In his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one overpowered him.

verses.text: No word surpassed him, and even in sleep his body prophesied.
verses.display_text: No word surpassed him, and even in sleep his body prophesied.

verses.text: In his life he performed portents, and at his end his works were wondrous.
verses.display_text: In his life he performed portents, and at his end his works were wondrous.

verses.text: Through all these things the people did not repent or turn away from their sins, until they were plundered from their land and scattered throughout all the earth.
verses.display_text: Through all these things the people did not repent or turn away from their sins, until they were plundered from their land and scattered throughout all the earth.

verses.text: The people were left few in number, with a ruler in David’s house. Some of them did what was pleasing, but others multiplied sins.
verses.display_text: The people were left few in number, with a ruler in David’s house. Some of them did what was pleasing, but others multiplied sins.

verses.text: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought water into its midst. With iron he dug through a steep rock and built reservoirs for water.
verses.display_text: Hezekiah fortified his city and brought water into its midst. With iron he dug through a steep rock and built reservoirs for water.

verses.text: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and he departed. He raised his hand against Zion and boasted greatly in his arrogance.
verses.display_text: In his days Sennacherib came up and sent Rabshakeh, and he departed. He raised his hand against Zion and boasted greatly in his arrogance.

verses.text: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered pangs like women giving birth.
verses.display_text: Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered pangs like women giving birth.

verses.text: They called upon the merciful Lord, spreading their hands toward Him. The Holy One quickly heard them from heaven and redeemed them by Isaiah’s hand.
verses.display_text: They called upon the merciful Lord, spreading their hands toward Him. The Holy One quickly heard them from heaven and redeemed them by Isaiah’s hand.

verses.text: He struck the Assyrians’ camp, and His angel destroyed them.
verses.display_text: He struck the Assyrians’ camp, and His angel destroyed them.

verses.text: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and stood strong in the ways of his father David, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, great and faithful in his vision.
verses.display_text: For Hezekiah did what was pleasing to the Lord and stood strong in the ways of his father David, which Isaiah the prophet commanded, great and faithful in his vision.

verses.text: In his days the sun went backward, and He added life to the king.
verses.display_text: In his days the sun went backward, and He added life to the king.

verses.text: With a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those mourning in Zion.
verses.display_text: With a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those mourning in Zion.

verses.text: He showed what would happen to the end of the age, and hidden things before they came to pass.
verses.display_text: He showed what would happen to the end of the age, and hidden things before they came to pass.

verses.text: The remembrance of Josiah is like a blend of incense prepared by a perfumer’s skill. In every mouth it will be sweet as honey, and like music at a wine banquet.
verses.display_text: The remembrance of Josiah is like a blend of incense prepared by a perfumer’s skill. In every mouth it will be sweet as honey, and like music at a wine banquet.

verses.text: He was rightly directed in bringing the people back, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.
verses.display_text: He was rightly directed in bringing the people back, and he removed the abominations of lawlessness.

verses.text: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in days of lawless people he strengthened godliness.
verses.display_text: He directed his heart toward the Lord; in days of lawless people he strengthened godliness.

verses.text: Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, they all committed offenses. For they abandoned the law of the Most High; the kings of Judah came to an end.
verses.display_text: Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, they all committed offenses. For they abandoned the law of the Most High; the kings of Judah came to an end.

verses.text: For they gave their horn to others and their glory to a foreign nation.
